**Description**

  
  

PRECONSTRUCTION DIRECTOR – DATA CENTERS  
This position can be based out of one of our regional office or fully remote.

About ArchKey

ArchKey is one of the nation’s largest privately held specialty trade installation and integrated facility service companies. We are a leader in designing, building and maintaining electrical, technologies and specialty systems. We’re the POWER behind making the improbable possible.

We’re electrifying the nation, energizing the future and bringing communities to life like never before. What we do today shapes the vision of tomorrow. Our work impacts lives long after the building is done. This means we are committed to building in ways that are not just technologically advanced, but sustainable, scalable and equitable by all. We’re not just energizing infrastructure, we’re energizing careers, communities, and the future.

Made up of the brightest minds in the industry, our team is our greatest asset, bringing knowledge, skills, and experience to every project. This is more than a call to join us, it’s an invitation to be part of a visionary journey, to grow with us as we scale.

About the Position

As a Preconstruction Director, you will be responsible for qualifying, cultivating, generating and fostering Data Center opportunities for the Company. Once those opportunities are qualified and obtained, this role ensures optimum financial positioning occurs. This position has complete oversite and responsibility for the teams that manage all preconstruction deliverables including estimates, design assistance, engineering, scope development, constructability, scheduling, overall execution strategy, JV creations, UBE plan, subcontractor solicitation, contract terms negotiations, long lead procurement, and initial billing associated with large scale Data Center projects and ensures thorough, exemplary customer communications and project results are achieved.

Our Ideal Candidate

  

* Is a proven leader, able to hire, coach, and develop a strong team of high performers.
* Has strong negotiation, conflict management, and persuasion skills, able to influence at all levels of the organization.
* Is an exceptional communicator, able to build strong internal and external business partner relationships while collaborating with cross-functional teams.

Day in the Life

  

* Directs and supervises the preconstruction managers who are responsible for each opportunity for quality and accuracy of work. This includes all preconstruction deliverables including estimates, design assistance, engineering, scope development, constructability, scheduling, overall execution strategy, JV creation, UBE plan, subcontractor solicitation, contract terms negotiations, long lead procurement, and initial billing performing estimates and bidding, assisting with establishing goals and communicating expected standards of performance and quality for others. Manages the interview procurement process.
* Determines which projects to pursue, based upon operational capacity, opportunity for cross-selling, strategic geographic opportunity for future growth.
* Ensures preconstruction management team partners with design department on design/build and design/assist projects to assure the project is designed to optimal achievable cost within the allotted budget. Manages preconstruction managers project workloads/specializations and provides problem resolution advice for preconstruction managers. Performs regular project risk assessment and mitigation.
* Supports preconstruction managers in planning, reviews, and helps coordinate all assigned preconstruction deliverables to maximize time and efficiency while delivering promises to customers and co-workers.
* Works with preconstruction managers to determine general expenses, labor rates, scope and other elements associated with the opportunities. Provides a detailed and comprehensive value analysis to the project team. Responsible for ensuring that all preconstruction deliverables are written appropriately and fulfilled to the customer’s and/or the company’s conditions for timing and quality satisfaction.
* Develops and maintains exemplary client and subcontractor relationships and conducts high-quality business development activities regularly. Supports the preconstruction managers who provide incremental cost analysis and scope updates for clients during the preconstruction phase. Maintains confidentiality of all client pricing and intellectual property.
* Creates and manages an annual Get and Complete budget and maintains some level of responsibility for companywide backlog.
* Build strategic and effective relationships with customers, project teams, specialist contractors, vendors, suppliers, user groups and others that reflect and support the company’s core values and meet or exceed the customer’s expectations.
* Provides regular and high-quality hiring, communications, mentoring, coaching, problem-solving and training for staff and other co-workers at all levels as needed. Advises and coaches employees and provides performance feedback regularly.

Minimum Qualifications

  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in engineering, construction management, building construction, architecture, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.
* Minimum 10+ years of electrical construction experience in estimating, common code requirements, and design/build estimating and preconstruction with a concentration in large commercial construction projects. Previous experience with field installation helpful. Minimum 5 years of experience directly managing people.
* Preferably 4-5 years of experience in hands-on project management. Extensive skills and experience in project management leadership. Thorough understanding of the project life cycle.
* Extensive experience with value analysis in all market segments and in-depth trade knowledge. Experience with computerized estimating software, preferably Accubid. Strong conceptual estimating skills, and experience in reviewing estimates for accuracy and completeness. Experience and skill in establishing budgets, business negotiation and vendor communication.
* Knowledge of building construction, materials, costs, systems, market conditions/trends, trade practices and regional differences. Must have extensive knowledge of the electrical code and skills to read, interpret and understand electrical contracts, plans, drawings, blueprints and specifications and financial documents. Strong technical understanding of electrical systems.
* Strong visionary strategic leadership and communication skills for employee groups at all levels, customers, subcontractors, vendors, and other community leaders. Exceptional business development, relationship building and client communication skills.
* Excellent written, verbal, listening, presentation, negotiation, conflict management and persuasion skills, and the ability to influence employees at all levels, including senior management.
Exceptional ability to coach, mentor, motivate and develop front line and senior level management, providing support to build highly performing, highly engaged teams and providing organizational and leadership guidance through periods of significant transition. Strong collaboration, teamwork, and interpersonal skills. Ability to work with and facilitate diverse work teams.  

Travel

* Approximately 50% of travel is expected and required.

  
**Salary Range**  

* $138,000 – $214,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.

Benefits

At ArchKey Solutions, our benefits package includes competitive health insurance options (medical, dental, and vision), a robust 401(k) retirement savings plan with employer match, paid time off and holidays, and access to wellness programs. Additionally, we offer professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement, and employee assistance programs to support your growth and well-being. We ensure that our benefits are designed to promote the health, security, and work-life balance of our employees. Additional information is available at Archkey.com.

Legal & Fraud Disclaimer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. We are an Affirmative Action, Equal Opportunity Employer. #CA30-1

Beware of fraudulent job postings. ArchKey Solutions only communicates through official channels. All official communication will come from an @archkey.com email address and we will never ask for financial information, payments, or personal details outside of the standard hiring process. To confirm the legitimacy of a job, visit our careers page or reach out to a member of our Talent Acquisition team.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

01b2e0dbfbe9b119f89c.title: HSE Manager - Major Projects
01b2e0dbfbe9b119f89c.description:
**Company Description**

**HSE Manager - Major Projects**

**Location:**

Flexible – remote work is an option when not travelling

**Travel:**

~40%

**Employment Type:**

Full-time

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll in the Americas has thousands of experts working across more than 70 offices. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Environment & Health, Water, Energy, and Planning & Urban Design.

 **Job Description**

**Position Overview**

This role provides senior HSE leadership for Ramboll Energy as well as other GBA major project portfolios in the Americas, with a primary focus on aligning HSE planning, governance, resourcing and execution across major projects, including EPC and EPCM delivery models. Rather than operating as the day-to-day HSE Manager for every project, the role will work upstream with internal stakeholders to ensure HSE is engaged early in business development, tendering, project planning and delivery preparation. The successful candidate will partner with Project Delivery, procurement, sales and tender management, engineering, commissioning and other key functions to make sure HSE risks, responsibilities, resource needs and delivery expectations are clearly understood before projects move into execution.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate will be a credible senior HSE professional with strong major-project experience, sound understanding of EPC and EPCM delivery models, and the ability to influence internal stakeholders before key commercial and delivery decisions are made. They will be comfortable operating across a portfolio of projects, strengthening the way HSE is integrated into the project delivery model, supporting Project HSE Managers where escalation is needed, and stepping into a project HSE Manager role only where project demand or resource constraints require direct deployment.

**Key Responsibilities**

Major Projects HSE Alignment & Governance

* Lead alignment of HSE expectations, planning requirements and governance arrangements for major projects across the Americas, including EPC and EPCM delivery models.
* Act as the senior HSE point of coordination between the GBA, Project Delivery, procurement, sales and tender management, engineering, commissioning and other internal stakeholders.
* Ensure HSE is engaged early in business development, tendering, project planning and delivery preparation so that risks, scope, budget and resource requirements are identified before commitments are made.
* Translate Ramboll and client HSE expectations into practical planning requirements that can be understood and applied by project, commercial and technical teams.
* Provide strategic HSE input during proposals, contract reviews and internal delivery planning to establish clear roles, responsibilities, interfaces and escalation routes before project execution begins.

**Early HSE Involvement, Planning & Resource Readiness**

* Build understanding across the Americas business of when and why HSE must be involved in major projects, particularly during tendering, contracting, mobilisation and execution planning.
* Work with internal stakeholders to define scalable HSE organisation structures, resource requirements and competency needs for major projects before execution risks materialise.
* Support project teams in identifying when dedicated Project HSE Manager support, specialist HSE input or additional project HSE resources are required.
* Ensure HSE requirements are embedded into project delivery plans, procurement strategies, contracting approaches, mobilisation plans and commissioning readiness activities.
* Where required due to resource demand, temporarily step into the Project HSE Manager role for major projects while maintaining focus on broader portfolio alignment and improvement.

**Internal Stakeholder Integration & Delivery Model Support**

* Work closely with Project Delivery, procurement, sales and tender management, engineering, commissioning and relevant business leaders to integrate HSE into the major project delivery model.
* Support internal teams in understanding how contract model, scope definition, client expectations and contractor interfaces affect HSE responsibility, capability and resourcing.
* Influence early commercial and technical decisions so that HSE obligations are realistic, adequately resourced and capable of being delivered in practice.
* Provide challenge and support to ensure HSE requirements are reflected in bid documents, contracts, procurement packages, contractor scopes of work and project execution documentation.
* Promote clear interfaces between Ramboll, clients, contractors, subcontractors and suppliers, particularly where EPC or EPCM delivery introduces complex responsibility boundaries.

**Escalation, Assurance & Continuous Improvement**

* Act as an escalation point for internal project HSE issues and project delivery challenges that cannot be resolved by the assigned Project HSE Manager or project team.
* Provide senior HSE support and challenge to Project HSE Managers, Project Directors and project leadership teams where risks, interfaces or stakeholder expectations require additional alignment.
* Review the effectiveness of HSE planning, governance, contractor management and assurance arrangements across major projects and identify opportunities to improve the delivery model.
* Lead or support assurance reviews, lessons-learned activities and management reviews to verify that HSE requirements are understood, resourced and consistently applied.
* Drive continuous improvement in how HSE supports major project delivery across the Americas, using project experience, performance trends and stakeholder feedback to strengthen future planning and execution.

**Culture, Engagement & Business Understanding**

* Strengthen business understanding of HSE’s role in major project success, particularly the need for early engagement, clear accountability and appropriate resourcing.
* Coach internal stakeholders and project leadership teams on effective HSE planning, escalation, contractor interface management and risk-based decision-making.
* Promote a learning-focused culture that uses project feedback, assurance findings and lessons learned to improve future major project delivery.

**Regulatory & Compliance Oversight**

* Provide oversight of compliance with applicable health, safety, and environmental regulations, client requirements, and Ramboll HSE standards across EPCM projects.
* Support project teams in translating regulatory and contractual HSE requirements into practical controls and assurance activities.
* Represent Ramboll in client audits, regulatory inspections, and EPCM governance meetings, ensuring actions are effectively tracked, communicated, and closed.

Performance Management & Reporting

* Establish consistent HSE performance reporting across EPCM projects, using leading and lagging indicators to identify trends, drive accountability, and improve performance.
* Translate performance data into clear insights, actions, and recommendations for project leadership, clients, contractors, and internal stakeholders.

 **Qualifications**

**Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health and Safety, Safety Management, Engineering, Environmental Health, Construction Management, or a related technical discipline.
* Professional HSE certification appropriate to the Americas market, with Certified Safety Professional (CSP) preferred or the ability to obtain CSP within an agreed timeframe.
* 10+ years of progressive HSE experience, including significant exposure to major projects, EPC, EPCM or complex construction management delivery models.
* Strong understanding of how HSE requirements are defined during tendering, contracting, procurement, mobilisation, project execution and commissioning.
* Proven ability to influence internal stakeholders, including project delivery, procurement, sales, tender management, engineering, commissioning and senior project leadership.
* Experience identifying project HSE resource needs, defining HSE scopes of work and supporting scalable organisation models for complex projects.
* Ability to provide senior escalation support where project HSE issues, stakeholder alignment or delivery model challenges require additional intervention.
* Working knowledge of construction-phase HSE controls, contractor management, incident investigation, assurance, regulatory compliance and management-system implementation.
* Ability to travel to project and stakeholder locations as required, while maintaining focus on portfolio-level alignment and improvement.
* Strong communication, facilitation, influencing and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred:**

* Degree-level education supported by significant major-project HSE experience may be considered where professional certification is in progress or an equivalent international route applies.
* Experience with energy transition, power, renewables, industrial de-carbonisation, chemicals, manufacturing, mining, or major infrastructure projects.
* Experience supporting owner’s EPCM models across multiple concurrent projects.
* International or remote project experience.

 **Additional Information**

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to shape how HSE is integrated into major project planning and execution across the Americas.
* A strategic role with influence across project delivery, commercial, technical and HSE stakeholders.
* Strong organizational commitment to safety, health, wellbeing, and continuous improvement.
* Professional development and career growth opportunities in a Global HSEQ organisation.

**Salary Transparency Statement**

At Ramboll, we are committed to fair and transparent compensation practices that support our people and our purpose of creating sustainable societies. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $136,000 to $197,000 yearly. This range reflects the compensation we reasonably expect to offer at the time of posting. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and internal equity. Because we operate across multiple U.S. markets, pay may differ depending on the cost of labor in specific locations. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for bonus, overtime or other forms of compensation and we offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports well-being, professional development, and work-life balance. Our recruiters are happy to share more about the specific salary range and total rewards package applicable to your location during the hiring process.

**Where People Flourish**

Our mission is to create sustainable societies where people and nature flourish. This means that a culture of inclusion is embedded in everything we do. Our people bring diverse backgrounds and experiences to the company, enabling us to deliver innovative and forward-thinking solutions to our clients. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We are committed to equal employment opportunity, regardless of age, disability or medical condition, gender identity, marriage and domestic partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, ancestry, or national origin, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation, military service and veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Ramboll wants to ensure opportunities are accessible to candidates with disabilities. So, please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it more comfortable for you. You can contact us at job.advert.accessibility@ramboll.com with such requests.

**How to apply**

Apply online. Attach your CV, cover letter and relevant documents showcasing why you are the right fit for the role, and when you are available to start. We look forward to receiving your application.

8693ba40c286de5c58d3.title: Manager, Customer Growth & Activation
8693ba40c286de5c58d3.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

**Manager, Customer Growth & Activation, WHI Solutions**

**Building the technology that powers automotive ecommerce.**

WHI Solutions, an eBay company, is an enterprise SaaS technology company powering the automotive parts industry. Our Nexpart platform is the B2B ecommerce marketplace that connects thousands of parts buyers and sellers across North America. Repair shops, dealerships, distributors and manufacturers use it to find, price and order parts, driving over $5 billion in transactions every year.

We're a technology-first company building at the cutting edge of automotive ecommerce. From AI-powered parts buying to business intelligence, we keep pushing what a B2B marketplace can do for the people who keep vehicles on the road.

Our team has been building together for decades, with a hand on the pulse of the automotive ecommerce marketplace the whole way. When you join WHI, you join a culture of builders: collaborative, welcoming, and serious about doing great work. We're looking for smart, focused, energetic people who are technology-forward and bring an open mind to new ideas. If that sounds like you, join WHI today!

**The Role and Opportunity**

The automotive B2B ecommerce market is evolving, and WHI is investing in a new, data-led way to grow our customer base. We are building a modern, CRM-driven approach to customer engagement, so we reach the right customers at the right moments with the right message. To run it, we are building a new Customer Growth & Activation team, and we are seeking a Manager, Customer Growth & Activation to lead it.

Reporting directly to the Head of Strategy, this person manages a team of CRM specialists who make a high volume of outbound calls to our customers. The ideal candidate is a hands-on Salesforce expert and a proven builder of high-performing teams. They design outreach programs, run call cadence and campaign strategy, and use data to guide where the team focuses. This is a remote role with occasional travel.

  
  

**What you will do:**

* Lead the day-to-day work of the CRM specialist team, coaching them to deliver against call, activation and engagement targets

* Set and manage call cadence and campaign strategy for outbound outreach to repair shops, dealerships and distributors

* Build and refine Salesforce workflows and templates that support targeted, timely customer outreach

* Use data to prioritize outreach and measure what works

* Continuously improve team processes and tools to increase productivity and results

* Drive Salesforce adoption and data quality across the team, so every call, customer touch and next step is captured

* Build reporting and dashboards, and share regular performance insights and recommendations with the Head of Strategy

* Help build out the team, partnering on hiring, onboarding and team structure

* Serve as a 'voice of the customer' to bring customer needs front and center in product development, sales strategy, and go-to-market plans

* Represent WHI at a handful of trade shows and industry events each year
  

  

**What you will bring:**

* 5+ years in inside sales, sales operations, customer growth or customer success, including 2+ years leading teams

* Proven track record of building and leading high-performing outbound or inside sales teams

* Deep, hands-on Salesforce experience, including workflows, reports and dashboards

* Experience launching or scaling a CRM-driven sales or customer engagement program

* Highly analytical and data-driven, comfortable setting targets and optimizing based on results

* Experience managing call cadences and multi-touch campaign strategy

* Strong ability to learn technical concepts and communicate them clearly to customers and team members

* Experience in automotive parts, aftermarket, dealership parts buying, or B2B ecommerce preferred

* BS/BA degree required

* Comfort in handling uncertainty and building something new

* Ability to travel occasionally to trade shows and industry events

* Highly collaborative – be fun, and easy to work with!
  

  

**Benefits and Compensation**

In addition to a competitive salary/commission structure, benefits are an essential part of your total compensation for the work you do every day. Whether you're single, in a growing family, or nearing retirement, eBay offers a variety of comprehensive and competitive benefit programs to meet your needs. Benefits include maternal & paternal leave, paid sabbatical, and plans to help ensure your financial security today and in the years ahead, because we know feeling financially secure during your working years and through retirement is important.

Here at WHI, we love creating opportunities for others by connecting people from widely diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and geographies. So, being diverse and inclusive isn't just something we strive for, it is who we are, and part of what we do each and every single day. We want to ensure that as an employee, you feel WHI is a place where, no matter who you are, you feel safe, included, and that you have the opportunity to bring your unique self to work. To learn about WHI's Diversity & Inclusion click here: https://www.ebayinc.com/company/diversity-inclusion/

**Location**

Remote, occasional travel required.

**Additional Details**

The base pay range for this position is expected in the range below:

$66,800 - $114,800

Base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a target bonus and restricted stock units (as applicable) in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as PTO and parental leave). Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

If hired, employees will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

Remote roles are not eligible for U.S. visa sponsorship.

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center and AI Hiring Guidelines.

**Description**

  
  

Engineering Design Manager  
This position can work out of any of our regional offices or fully remote.

About ArchKey

ArchKey is one of the nation’s largest privately held specialty trade installation and integrated facility service companies. We are a leader in designing, building and maintaining electrical, technologies and specialty systems. We’re the POWER behind making the improbable possible.  
  
We’re electrifying the nation, energizing the future and bringing communities to life like never before. What we do today shapes the vision of tomorrow. Our work impacts lives long after the building is done. This means we are committed to building in ways that are not just technologically advanced, but sustainable, scalable and equitable by all. We’re not just energizing infrastructure, we’re energizing careers, communities, and the future.

Made up of the brightest minds in the industry, our team is our greatest asset bringing knowledge, skills, and experience to every project. This is more than a call to join us, it’s an invitation to be part of a visionary journey, to grow with us as we scale.

About the position

The Engineering Design Manager provides strategic, technical, and people leadership to multiple teams of engineers and designers responsible for delivering high-quality electrical engineering drawings, specifications, 3D models, and construction documents that support complex electrical installations in the field, in alignment with all Company policies, procedures, key objectives and regulations. This role requires a proven leader with a strong track record of mentoring, training, and developing engineering talent while ensuring consistent delivery of accurate, code-compliant, and constructible designs under demanding schedules. The Engineering Design Manager oversees engineering execution across projects ranging from small Design/Build efforts to some of the largest hyper-scale projects in the country. In addition to technical oversight, this position plays a key role in job solicitation, estimating, scheduling, quality control, and problem resolution in alignment with department policies, business objectives, and regulatory requirements.

Our Ideal Candidate

* Is a proven leader, able to hire, coach, and develop a strong team of high performers.
* Has strong negotiation, conflict management, and persuasion skills, able to influence at all levels of the organization.
* Has a growth mindset and is always looking to continually learn and grow.

Day in the life

* Leads and manages multiple teams of engineers and designers, overseeing the development of detailed electrical engineering permit drawings, specifications, 3D models, and construction installation documents.
* Provides technical leadership in the development of conceptual designs, design alternatives, and value engineering solutions in collaboration with field leadership, project managers, and estimators.
* Oversees and as required, prepares and/or reviews electrical calculations, engineering studies, specifications, reports, and technical correspondence throughout all phases of construction.
* Provides oversight and technical approval for engineering studies including arc flash, short circuit, overcurrent protective device (OCPD) coordination, duct bank ampacity, load lighting, and power factor correction.
* Coordinates with field teams to support data collection and implementation as needed.
* Monitors and evaluates the performance of engineering teams to achieve high levels of quality, productivity, and schedule adherence.
* Resolves escalated technical issues, approves plan revisions, and supports complex problem resolution.
* Provides coaching, mentoring, and regular performance feedback to engineers and designers.
* Plans and coordinates team workloads across multiple concurrent projects to ensure staffing efficiency, balanced utilization, and on-time delivery of design packages.
* Establishes, enforces, and continuously improves engineering standards, design criteria, and QA/QC processes to ensure consistent quality across all deliverables.
* Demonstrates expert knowledge of local and national energy codes and standards (e.g., IECC, ASHRAE 90.1, California Title 24), including leading development and review of drawings for energy code compliance, evaluating lighting fixtures, controls, and systems for regulatory compliance, utilizing energy compliance software and documentation processes, and advising project managers and clients on compliance strategies and risk mitigation.
* Identifies and implements improvements to engineering standards, workflows, tools, and procedures.
* Promotes continuous learning and professional development within the department.
* Stays current with evolving electrical and safety codes, materials, technologies, and industry best practices.
* Proactively identifies opportunities to expand and deploy engineering services across the ArchKey platform.
* Consistently makes decisions in an attentive and safe manner to ensure the safety and health of self and others.
* Utilizes LEAN concepts or other continuous improvement methodologies to ensure the most efficient operations, processes, and activities.
* Promotes and models the Company mission, vision and values through exercising sound and ethical business practices, championing all elements of diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) and providing high quality services and programs as they relate to clients, subcontractors, co-workers, suppliers, and the public.

Minimum Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering from an ABET-accredited program; Professional Engineer (PE) license required, with the ability to obtain licensure in multiple states.
* 11-12 years of experience in facilities power design, including lighting, receptacle layouts, circuiting, panelboard schedules, load calculations, and equipment sizing.
* Demonstrated experience successfully leading, mentoring, and developing engineering teams across projects of varying size and complexity.
* Experience in healthcare, heavy industrial, and/or data center projects is highly desirable. Controls experience is a plus.
* Advanced ability to read, interpret, and apply electrical contracts, drawings, and specifications, with extensive knowledge of the National Electrical Code (NEC) and applicable building codes.
* Proficiency with Revit, Autodesk tools, Bluebeam, and Microsoft Office.
* Experience performing and reviewing engineering studies using SKM or ETAP.
* Strong commitment to electrical construction, engineering excellence, and people leadership, with a collaborative and accountability-driven management style.
* Proven experience supporting field electricians through all phases of construction, including troubleshooting and complex issue resolution.
* Demonstrated experience proposing, scoping, estimating, and scheduling engineering design efforts.
* Proven ability to manage the workload and performance of teams of four or more professionals across multiple projects.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment, managing competing priorities with strong organizational and decision-making skills.
* Strong mathematical, analytical, and systems-level problem-solving capabilities.
* Demonstrated sound judgment, customer focus, and effective conflict resolution skills.
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to lead teams and collaborate across disciplines

Travel

* Occasional travel may be required.

Salary Range

* $120,000 – $185,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.

Benefits

At ArchKey Solutions, our benefits package includes competitive health insurance options (medical, dental, and vision), a robust 401(k) retirement savings plan with employer match, paid time off and holidays, and access to wellness programs. Additionally, we offer professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement, and employee assistance programs to support your growth and well-being. We ensure that our benefits are designed to promote the health, security, and work-life balance of our employees. Additional information is available at Archkey.com.

All official communication will come from an @archkey.com email address and we will never ask for financial information, payments, or personal details outside of the standard hiring process. 4e494b6f401d8144c37e.title: Customer Success Manager
4e494b6f401d8144c37e.description:
Position Overview
  
Hubexo North America is seeking a proactive, results-driven Customer Success Manager (CSM) to manage a portfolio of customer accounts and drive long-term customer value through onboarding, product adoption, engagement, retention, and growth.
  
The CSM is responsible for developing strong customer relationships, ensuring customers realize measurable value from Hubexo's solutions, and proactively managing the customer lifecycle.
  
This is a revenue-accountable role with direct responsibility for customer retention, renewal execution, and achieving Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) targets.
  
The ideal candidate combines strong relationship management skills with commercial awareness, analytical capabilities, and a demonstrated ability to manage subscription renewals.
  
The CSM will collaborate closely with Sales, Customer Care, Product, Finance, and Revenue Operations to deliver a consistent and successful customer experience.
  

* This role is 100$ remote. Candidate must live in one of the following states to be considered for the role:

AL, AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, MD, ME, MI, MN, NC, NJ, NY, NM, NV, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WI
  
Key Responsibilities
  
1. Customer Portfolio Management & Retention
  

* Own and manage an assigned portfolio of customer accounts throughout the customer lifecycle.
* Develop proactive account strategies focused on customer satisfaction, adoption, retention, and long-term value.
* Take direct ownership of customer renewal planning, engagement, and execution.
* Meet or exceed assigned Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) targets.
* Identify accounts at risk of cancellation, downsell, or nonrenewal and implement documented retention strategies.
* Maintain accurate renewal forecasts and proactively address potential revenue risks.
* Identify expansion opportunities and collaborate with Sales to support account growth.
* Build strong relationships with customer stakeholders, decision-makers, and executive sponsors.

2. Proactive Customer Engagement & Relationship Management
  

* Establish regular, meaningful communication with customers to understand their goals, challenges, and evolving business needs.
* Conduct scheduled customer meetings, account reviews, and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs).
* Serve as a trusted advisor by aligning Hubexo solutions with customer objectives and demonstrating measurable value.
* Proactively engage customers well in advance of renewal dates to assess satisfaction, adoption, and future needs.
* Maintain consistent outreach through personalized emails, telephone calls, and customer meetings.
* Meet established customer engagement and activity KPIs, including defined expectations for calls, emails, meetings, and follow-up activities.
* Maintain professional, timely communication and ensure customer commitments are consistently fulfilled.

3. Customer Onboarding, Adoption & Success
  

* Coordinate with Customer Care and internal teams to ensure a successful transition from Sales through onboarding and activation.
* Establish customer success goals and monitor progress toward achieving desired outcomes.
* Promote product adoption by identifying opportunities for additional education, training, and feature utilization.
* Monitor customer health, usage patterns, engagement, and satisfaction to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Partner with Customer Care and Support teams to ensure timely resolution of customer inquiries and technical issues.
* Identify and address barriers that may negatively impact customer adoption, satisfaction, or retention.

4. Renewal & Revenue Management
  

* Manage the renewal lifecycle to ensure contracts are reviewed, customer engagement occurs proactively, and renewals are processed accurately and on time.
* Maintain accurate renewal dates, contract terms, subscription information, and account records.
* Support company pricing and renewal strategies while identifying and escalating potential renewal risks.
* Track and analyze key financial and retention metrics, including:
* Gross Revenue Retention (GRR)
* Net Revenue Retention (NRR)
* Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR)
* Renewal rates
* Customer churn and downsell
* Account health and engagement
* Partner with Finance, Sales, and Revenue Operations to resolve contract, billing, and renewal discrepancies.
* Maintain accurate and timely renewal forecasts and account-level retention plans.

5. CRM Management, Reporting & Accountability
  

* Maintain complete, accurate, and current customer information in HubSpot, including account ownership, contract details, renewal opportunities, activities, and customer interactions.
* Document customer communications, meetings, renewal discussions, risks, and follow-up commitments.
* Use CRM dashboards and reporting tools to monitor account health, renewal pipelines, customer engagement, and individual performance.
* Consistently achieve established performance expectations related to customer outreach, account management, retention, and renewal execution.
* Demonstrate strong organizational skills, time management, and accountability in managing a portfolio of customer accounts.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes, reporting accuracy, and customer lifecycle management.

6. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Customer Advocacy
  

* Partner with Sales to ensure effective customer handoffs and identify opportunities for account expansion.
* Collaborate with Customer Care to coordinate onboarding, training, support, and issue resolution.
* Work with Product teams to communicate customer feedback, product challenges, and enhancement opportunities.
* Coordinate with Finance and Revenue Operations to maintain accurate billing, contract, and renewal information.
* Advocate for customer needs while balancing customer satisfaction with company policies and business objectives.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen customer experience, operational efficiency, and retention performance.

Required Qualifications
  

* Minimum 3 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar B2B customer-facing role.
* Demonstrated experience managing a portfolio of customer accounts with responsibility for customer retention and renewals.
* Proven track record of meeting or exceeding customer retention, renewal, or revenue-related performance targets.
* Experience working with SaaS, subscription-based services, data solutions, or software products.
* Strong understanding of subscription renewals, contract management, customer lifecycle management, and recurring revenue.
* Ability to identify customer churn risks, develop retention strategies, and execute proactive account plans.
* Strong relationship-building, communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* Experience conducting customer business reviews and communicating value to decision-makers.
* Proficiency with CRM systems and maintaining accurate customer records.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret customer engagement, account health, and retention reporting.
* Ability to independently manage multiple accounts, competing priorities, and deadlines in a remote environment.
* Demonstrated accountability, initiative, problem-solving ability, and results-driven performance.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across departments and contribute to a positive customer experience.

Preferred Qualifications
  

* Experience using HubSpot CRM, including deal pipelines, activities, reporting, and customer account management.
* Familiarity with GRR, NRR, ARR, churn, and subscription revenue reporting.
* Experience supporting customers in the construction, building products, market intelligence, or construction technology industries.
* Experience managing contract renewals, pricing discussions, and customer retention negotiations.
* Experience developing customer success plans and facilitating executive business reviews.
* Experience working in an international or multi-brand organization.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Communications, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Performance Expectations
  
Success in this role will be measured through a combination of customer outcomes, revenue retention, and proactive account management.
  
  
**Key performance indicators include:**  

* Customer Retention: Achievement of assigned GRR and renewal performance targets.
* Renewal Execution: Timely processing of renewals and proactive management of upcoming renewal opportunities.
* Customer Engagement: Consistent achievement of established personalized outreach, call, and meeting expectations.
* Account Health: Identification and management of churn risks, customer adoption challenges, and retention opportunities.
* CRM Accuracy: Complete and timely documentation of customer interactions, account information, and renewal activities.
* Customer Experience: Responsiveness, relationship quality, customer satisfaction, and successful resolution of escalated concerns.

Specific performance targets and activity expectations will be communicated by Customer Success leadership.
  
  
Why Hubexo We’re not here to coast - we’re here to challenge, grow, and build better. For our people and for our customers. That means we’ll expect a lot from you: ownership, precision, and a drive to lead by example. In return, you’ll get the space to dream big, take smart risks, and be seen, heard, and valued.

65ab337f1050184c8b77.title: Manager, Customer Support
65ab337f1050184c8b77.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

Fullsteam is a leading provider of vertical software and embedded payments technology dedicated to helping businesses flourish by providing their customers with seamless experiences. With a dynamic and growing team of over 1,900 employees, we are committed to driving innovation and delivering best-in-class software and payment solutions that empower small and medium-sized businesses across numerous industries. Our purpose is to help our customers grow their businesses and delight their customers. Join us and be a part of a forward-thinking company that values growth, excellence, and the success of our clients.

Arryved, part of the Fullsteam organization, is a SaaS company specializing in Point-of-Sale solutions for the craft beverage and hospitality industry. From taprooms and brewpubs to mobile ordering and online sales, Arryved helps businesses deliver seamless customer experiences for passionate craft communities.

**Job Summary:**

The **Manager, Customer Support** leads the customer support team and is accountable for team performance, service delivery, and continuous improvement of support operations. This role translates department priorities into team goals, sets expectations, coaches and develops employees, and manages staffing and coverage to deliver consistent service from initial customer contact through resolution. The Manager uses support KPIs to identify performance gaps and drive improvements in service levels, workflows, and documentation. As the escalation owner for complex customer issues, the Manager guides resolution and engages directly when needed, while partnering with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales to address customer feedback and prepare the team for product changes.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Provide direct people leadership for the customer support team, including setting goals and expectations, assigning work, conducting regular one-on-ones, coaching performance, and fostering an accountable, inclusive, high-performing culture.
* Manage key aspects of the employee lifecycle for the team, including participating in interviews and selection, supporting onboarding, providing ongoing coaching and development, completing performance reviews, recognizing contributions, and addressing performance concerns.
* Establish team priorities, service standards, and operating rhythms; translate department goals into clear individual and team deliverables and hold the team accountable for results.
* Manage team capacity and coverage through staffing plans, schedules, on-call rotations, and holiday coverage. Assess workload against available capacity, adjust assignments and coverage to maintain service levels, and identify staffing gaps requiring leadership decisions.
* Own team performance against support KPIs, including response time, customer satisfaction (CSAT), first-contact resolution (FCR), ticket backlog, and quality. Review trends, identify root causes of performance gaps, implement team-level improvement plans, and communicate results and progress against service expectations.
* Monitor queues and team capacity, make real-time prioritization and resource-allocation decisions, and ensure timely, effective resolution of support tickets across all levels.
* Own the escalation-management process for high-impact, complex, or at-risk customer cases. Establish clear resolution ownership, coordinate the appropriate resources, and ensure timely customer communication, follow-through, and documented resolution; engage directly when the issue requires managerial intervention.
* Serve as the team’s technical and operational escalation point, guiding employees through ambiguous issues and determining when to involve Product, Engineering, Customer Success, or senior leadership.
* Lead support-operations improvements across processes, workflows, the knowledge base, quality assurance, and training. Prioritize opportunities using service data and customer feedback, guide implementation and team adoption, and evaluate whether changes improve efficiency, consistency, and scalability.
* Identify customer-risk patterns and partner with Customer Success and Sales on retention strategies and coordinated action plans.
* Represent the voice of the customer by synthesizing support trends and actionable feedback for Product, Engineering, Sales, and other stakeholders.
* Lead support-team readiness for new features and product changes by coordinating employee training, documentation updates, and escalation planning with cross-functional partners. Identify readiness gaps before launch and use post-launch feedback to address support issues and improve future rollouts.

**Skills & Competencies:**

* Demonstrated people-leadership capability, including setting expectations, coaching employees, addressing performance concerns, developing talent, and creating accountability across a team.
* Sound judgment in balancing customer impact, employee capacity, service levels, and established business priorities in a fast-paced environment, including knowing when to escalate decisions or risks to senior leadership.
* Experience owning customer escalations with empathy, clarity, urgency, and disciplined follow-through.
* Demonstrated ownership of strategic support initiatives that improve efficiency, customer satisfaction, quality, and scalability.
* Ability to translate company objectives into measurable team goals, operating plans, and individual expectations.
* Strong analytical skills, including experience building or using dashboards, interpreting performance data, identifying root causes, and adjusting team priorities based on evidence.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, with the ability to tailor messaging for employees, customers, executives, and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Strong cross-functional influence, facilitation, conflict-resolution, and change-management skills across remote and in-person environments.
* Sufficient technical aptitude to troubleshoot foundational issues, assess risk, guide team members, and coordinate effective escalation paths.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 4+ years of progressive experience in customer support, technical support, customer success, or a related software environment, including experience serving as a team lead, supervisor, or people manager.
* 1–2 years of experience leading or supervising employees, including accountability for team results, coaching and development, workload coordination, and performance feedback; experience supporting a customer or technical support team is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience conducting performance reviews, setting measurable expectations, providing documented feedback, addressing underperformance, and building development plans.
* Experience hiring, onboarding, and retaining employees and building inclusive, collaborative team cultures.
* Experience monitoring team KPIs, service-level performance, ticket queues, or team capacity and using available data to support improvement plans.
* Strong process-oriented mindset with a track record of building and optimizing workflows, support documentation, quality practices, and training programs.
* Experience leading escalations and partnering cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, or Sales to resolve customer and operational issues.
* Familiarity with support tools such as Zoho Desk, Salesforce, or comparable ticketing and customer-management platforms.
* Experience supporting software systems; experience in SaaS, point-of-sale, hospitality technology, or another operationally complex customer environment is preferred.

**Salary range: $81,000 - $88,500 USD**

Fullsteam supports an inclusive workplace that values diversity of thought, experience, and background. Fullsteam is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, veteran status, marital status, creed, status with regard to public assistance, genetic status or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law.

ac2c13b11e41efb19a1a.title: Manager, Provider Operations - Provider Data
ac2c13b11e41efb19a1a.description:
**Job Description**

***A bit about this role:***

Accurate, complete, and timely provider data is foundational to how we serve our members and support our providers. It powers the provider directory, helps members find and navigate care, reduces administrative burden for providers, and supports critical processes including claims, utilization management, credentialing, network operations, care navigation, and reporting. Because provider data is complex, interconnected, and constantly changing, strong processes to monitor, verify, and improve its accuracy are essential to our member and provider experiences, operational performance, and compliance with federal and state requirements.

The Manager will help drive operational excellence across the provider data lifecycle—from onboarding and initial configuration through ongoing maintenance and verification—with particular focus on ensuring that records affecting member care are accurate, complete, and up to date. By connecting operational insights, stakeholder feedback, and data trends, this person will identify opportunities to strengthen processes, improve data quality, and prevent issues before they impact members, providers, or downstream business operations. We’re looking for a self-starter who can bring structure to ambiguous problems, manage multiple initiatives, and move work from insight to implementation.

***Your responsibilities and impact will include:***

* Support and advance initiatives that improve the accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and scalability of provider and facility data operations from onboarding through ongoing maintenance and verification
* Help oversee the operating performance of offshore teams and automated solutions supporting provider data and verification initiatives, including monitoring quality, productivity, capacity, and issue trends
* Develop and maintain reporting, dashboards, and monitoring that provide visibility into operational performance, verification results, data quality trends, emerging risks, and opportunities for intervention
* Partner with product and engineering to define requirements, test enhancements, and improve the usability, accuracy, and scalability of verification tools and workflows
* Help design, build, and monitor AI agents and other automation solutions that improve the efficiency, scalability, and accuracy of provider data operations and initiatives
* Analyze root causes of recurring data issues and recommend process, tooling, or upstream improvements that prevent issues from recurring
* Partner with claims and other internal data teams to develop reporting and analyses that quantify the operational and business impact of provider data issues
* Serve as a flexible operational leader who can build structure in ambiguous environments, take on new problem areas, and shift priorities as business and member needs evolve

***Required skills and experience:***

* Bachelor’s degree and 3–5+ years of relevant experience in healthcare operations, provider data, provider directory, credentialing, claims, network operations, data quality, or a related field
* Experience managing operational workflows involving provider data, record validation, data quality, research, verification, or issue remediation
* Demonstrated ability to build, document, and scale repeatable operational processes with measurable quality and productivity outcomes
* Strong analytical skills, including the ability to investigate data issues, identify patterns and anomalies, and translate findings into clear operational actions
* Experience building or maintaining dashboards, reporting, or monitoring tools to identify risks and track performance
* Experience partnering with product and engineering teams to define requirements, test enhancements, and improve operational tooling
* Strong project management, communication, and organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize competing needs and work effectively with offshore teams and cross-functional partners
* Self-directed and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment with ambiguity and evolving priorities

***Desired skills and experience:***

* Experience managing or scaling offshore, vendor, or shared-services teams
* Experience applying AI, agentic workflows, machine learning, or automation to reduce manual operational work
* SQL or equivalent ability to query, join, and validate provider, claims, or operational data directly
* Familiarity with provider directory requirements, CMS Medicare Advantage directory accuracy expectations, or other healthcare data and network regulations

***Salary Range:*** $73,000-$115,000/year

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

* Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium
* Generous paid time off

The Senior Director Sales & Customer Support is responsible for driving the growth, customer retention, customer experience, and strategic direction of Ryder's mobile maintenance business. This position is accountable for developing and executing a comprehensive go-to-market strategy designed to accelerate revenue growth, increase market penetration, strengthen customer loyalty, and maximize customer lifetime value. The incumbent leads a multi-functional organization responsible for acquiring new customers, expanding existing customer relationships, improving customer outcomes, and delivering best-in-class customer support. This role serves as the owner of the customer lifecycle and is accountable for achieving revenue growth, retention, customer satisfaction, and profitability objectives for the mobile maintenance product line.

**Essential Functions**

* Strategy & Revenue Growth:• Develop and execute the strategic sales plan for the Mobile Maintenance business to achieve revenue, profitability, and market share objectives. • Lead national business development efforts focused on new customer acquisition and strategic account expansion. • Establish sales objectives, forecasting processes, pipeline management disciplines, and performance metrics. • Evaluate emerging market opportunities, competitive threats, and industry trends to support growth initiatives. • Ensure execution of commercial strategies that maximize revenue generation and customer retention.

b172a64268b01ee3bb69.description:
**Description**

  
  

PRECONSTRUCTION DIRECTOR – DATA CENTERS  
This position can be based out of one of our regional office or fully remote.

About ArchKey

ArchKey is one of the nation’s largest privately held specialty trade installation and integrated facility service companies. We are a leader in designing, building and maintaining electrical, technologies and specialty systems. We’re the POWER behind making the improbable possible.

We’re electrifying the nation, energizing the future and bringing communities to life like never before. What we do today shapes the vision of tomorrow. Our work impacts lives long after the building is done. This means we are committed to building in ways that are not just technologically advanced, but sustainable, scalable and equitable by all. We’re not just energizing infrastructure, we’re energizing careers, communities, and the future.

Made up of the brightest minds in the industry, our team is our greatest asset, bringing knowledge, skills, and experience to every project. This is more than a call to join us, it’s an invitation to be part of a visionary journey, to grow with us as we scale.

About the Position

As a Preconstruction Director, you will be responsible for qualifying, cultivating, generating and fostering Data Center opportunities for the Company. Once those opportunities are qualified and obtained, this role ensures optimum financial positioning occurs. This position has complete oversite and responsibility for the teams that manage all preconstruction deliverables including estimates, design assistance, engineering, scope development, constructability, scheduling, overall execution strategy, JV creations, UBE plan, subcontractor solicitation, contract terms negotiations, long lead procurement, and initial billing associated with large scale Data Center projects and ensures thorough, exemplary customer communications and project results are achieved.

Our Ideal Candidate

  

* Is a proven leader, able to hire, coach, and develop a strong team of high performers.
* Has strong negotiation, conflict management, and persuasion skills, able to influence at all levels of the organization.
* Is an exceptional communicator, able to build strong internal and external business partner relationships while collaborating with cross-functional teams.

Day in the Life

  

* Directs and supervises the preconstruction managers who are responsible for each opportunity for quality and accuracy of work. This includes all preconstruction deliverables including estimates, design assistance, engineering, scope development, constructability, scheduling, overall execution strategy, JV creation, UBE plan, subcontractor solicitation, contract terms negotiations, long lead procurement, and initial billing performing estimates and bidding, assisting with establishing goals and communicating expected standards of performance and quality for others. Manages the interview procurement process.
* Determines which projects to pursue, based upon operational capacity, opportunity for cross-selling, strategic geographic opportunity for future growth.
* Ensures preconstruction management team partners with design department on design/build and design/assist projects to assure the project is designed to optimal achievable cost within the allotted budget. Manages preconstruction managers project workloads/specializations and provides problem resolution advice for preconstruction managers. Performs regular project risk assessment and mitigation.
* Supports preconstruction managers in planning, reviews, and helps coordinate all assigned preconstruction deliverables to maximize time and efficiency while delivering promises to customers and co-workers.
* Works with preconstruction managers to determine general expenses, labor rates, scope and other elements associated with the opportunities. Provides a detailed and comprehensive value analysis to the project team. Responsible for ensuring that all preconstruction deliverables are written appropriately and fulfilled to the customer’s and/or the company’s conditions for timing and quality satisfaction.
* Develops and maintains exemplary client and subcontractor relationships and conducts high-quality business development activities regularly. Supports the preconstruction managers who provide incremental cost analysis and scope updates for clients during the preconstruction phase. Maintains confidentiality of all client pricing and intellectual property.
* Creates and manages an annual Get and Complete budget and maintains some level of responsibility for companywide backlog.
* Build strategic and effective relationships with customers, project teams, specialist contractors, vendors, suppliers, user groups and others that reflect and support the company’s core values and meet or exceed the customer’s expectations.
* Provides regular and high-quality hiring, communications, mentoring, coaching, problem-solving and training for staff and other co-workers at all levels as needed. Advises and coaches employees and provides performance feedback regularly.

Minimum Qualifications

  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in engineering, construction management, building construction, architecture, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.
* Minimum 10+ years of electrical construction experience in estimating, common code requirements, and design/build estimating and preconstruction with a concentration in large commercial construction projects. Previous experience with field installation helpful. Minimum 5 years of experience directly managing people.
* Preferably 4-5 years of experience in hands-on project management. Extensive skills and experience in project management leadership. Thorough understanding of the project life cycle.
* Extensive experience with value analysis in all market segments and in-depth trade knowledge. Experience with computerized estimating software, preferably Accubid. Strong conceptual estimating skills, and experience in reviewing estimates for accuracy and completeness. Experience and skill in establishing budgets, business negotiation and vendor communication.
* Knowledge of building construction, materials, costs, systems, market conditions/trends, trade practices and regional differences. Must have extensive knowledge of the electrical code and skills to read, interpret and understand electrical contracts, plans, drawings, blueprints and specifications and financial documents. Strong technical understanding of electrical systems.
* Strong visionary strategic leadership and communication skills for employee groups at all levels, customers, subcontractors, vendors, and other community leaders. Exceptional business development, relationship building and client communication skills.
* Excellent written, verbal, listening, presentation, negotiation, conflict management and persuasion skills, and the ability to influence employees at all levels, including senior management.
Exceptional ability to coach, mentor, motivate and develop front line and senior level management, providing support to build highly performing, highly engaged teams and providing organizational and leadership guidance through periods of significant transition. Strong collaboration, teamwork, and interpersonal skills. Ability to work with and facilitate diverse work teams.  

Travel

* Approximately 50% of travel is expected and required.

  
**Salary Range**  

* $138,000 – $214,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.

Benefits

Our Quality organization ensures every single material inside our products is manufactured, processed, tested, packaged, stored, and distributed in alignment with our incredibly high standards of quality while meeting all regulatory requirements. Partnering across our internal manufacturing facilities, external contract manufacturers, and suppliers, we create an interdependent global manufacturing network committed to delivering a compliant, reliable supply to customers and patients on time, every time, across the globe.
  
  
The Associate Director within Quality is responsible for providing quality direction and oversight to a Drug Substance capital project according to our quality systems, including Training, Documentation, Change Control, Inspection Management, Quality Management System, and Risk Management to maintain compliance with regulatory requirements.
  
  
The individual is an advocate and leader for the development, execution, and deployment of the site and end-to-end priorities. The Associate Director drives quality improvement activities and ensures alignment across the organization in the execution of their assigned areas. The Associate Director is responsible for quality oversight of the Capital Project and the associated Quality Systems.
  
  
The qualified candidate ensures compliance with divisional, company, and site standards and procedures.
  
  
This is an individual contributor role and partners with the operations and technical operations leaders to ensure that the facility will be designed and qualified in alignment with approved processes and comply with all applicable regulatory and internal requirements.
  
  
The selected candidate will play an active role in regulatory inspections, interacting directly with regulatory inspectors when the facility moves to pre-approval inspections. The qualified candidate must demonstrate strong analytical and scientific acumen to assist with the troubleshooting of processes and systems, as well as excellent leadership capabilities. These include cross-functional collaboration, written and verbal communication skills, structured problem solving skills, disciplined decision-making, and talent management experience.

5c9dd0200013355331ae.description:
**About the Position**

HEJ Property Group is looking for an organized, dependable, and detail-oriented Property Coordinator to support company leadership and help run the day-to-day operations of our commercial properties.

The role combines administrative work, tenant communication, vendor coordination, bookkeeping support, and following property issues through to resolution. Our properties are in several states, so you’ll coordinate remotely with tenants, vendors, and on-site contacts. The ideal candidate is comfortable managing multiple priorities, solving problems, and working independently in a fast-paced environment.

**Responsibilities**

* Provide administrative support, including emails, scheduling, document preparation, reports, and recordkeeping.
* Communicate with tenants about questions, maintenance requests, access, and general property concerns.
* Manage tenant issues through resolution, including late rent follow-up and difficult conversations.
* Coordinate vendors, contractors, building maintenance, inspections, and service appointments.
* Coordinate insurance claims, repairs, and contractor work across out-of-state properties.
* Track outstanding repairs, projects, invoices, and other items that need follow-up.
* Assist with bookkeeping, invoice review, expense tracking, tenant billing, and payment records.
* Review vendor invoices and service reports for accuracy and follow up on discrepancies.
* Maintain property files, contracts, insurance documents, inspection reports, and other records.
* Assist with tenant onboarding, property management software, and electronic payment setup.
* Keep management informed of property issues, project updates, and items needing attention.

**Qualifications**

* Experience as an administrative assistant, office coordinator, property coordinator, or in a similar role.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Outlook.
* Able to manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and follow through without constant supervision.
* Professional, dependable, and comfortable working with tenants, vendors, and management.
* Basic bookkeeping or invoice processing experience preferred.
* Experience with commercial or industrial properties is a strong plus.

Property management software experience, particularly Rent Manager, is a plus.  
We’re looking for someone who takes initiative, stays organized, communicates well, and can be counted on to keep daily tasks and ongoing issues moving forward.

Pay: $23.00 - $25.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

b746606b938fbbadaedb.description:
