### **Highlights**

* Location Remote, US
* Start Date Dec 1, 2026
* Work Location Allows Remote Work

### **Skills**

* Structured Hiring Method
* Talent Acquisition
* Team Leadership
* Evidence Based Decision Making

### **Description**

**About MatrixCare**
--------------------

MatrixCare provides software solutions to more than 15,000 providers supporting skilled nursing, senior living and long-term care, life plan communities, and home health and hospice care. A multi-year winner of the Best in KLAS award, MatrixCare is trusted by thousnds of facility-based and home-based care organizations to improve provider efficiencies and promote a better quality of life for the people they serve. For more information, visit www.matrixcare.com.

**About the Role**
------------------

The Director, Talent Acquisition will build the talent acquisition engine that staffs MatrixCare with A Players. MatrixCare is a newly independent, private equity-backed company with a multi-year value creation plan, and the hiring behind that plan has to be fast, consistent, and high quality. You will stand up the function from the ground up which includes a hybrid model of in-house recruiters and a recruitment process outsourcing (RPO) partner, a structured hiring method used for every role, recruiting live on Dayforce, and an employer brand that brings A Players to us directly. You will lead a team of three to four recruiters, own the RPO relationship, and work directly with the Chief People Officer and the executive team. We are seeking a hands-on recruiting leader who has built a function before, holds a high bar on evidence over instinct, and manages hiring like an operator who owns the numbers.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Build the hiring forecast from the value creation plan and refresh it quarterly with Finance so every open role is planned, funded, and filled within the days-to-fill estimate for its type.
* Lead a structured hiring method (the A Method) across the company so every hire follows a role card, structured screen, and reference process, and train all hiring managers to use it.
* Hire, develop, and lead a team of three to four internal recruiters who hold the same quality bar and are productive within their first six months.
* Design and run the hybrid in-house and RPO model.
* Stand up recruiting on Dayforce, including migrating every in-house and RPO requisition, so funnel, aging, and source data are reported weekly from one system.
* Deliver a monthly talent acquisition dashboard to the executive team covering quality of hire, source of hire, time to fill, and hiring manager and candidate satisfaction.
* Own the hiring manager and candidate experience end to end, setting clear service levels for response time, interview scheduling, feedback, and offer turnaround, surveying both groups after every search, and acting on the results so satisfaction stays at 90% or above.
* Build the employer brand strategy and employee value proposition, refresh the careers page, and grow direct-sourced hires each half so agency reliance falls over time.
* Manage agency and blended cost per hire within budget.
* Maintain an A Player bench for every critical role so succession and backfill plans are ready before they are needed.
* Partner with executives as a trusted advisor on the talent market, compensation realities, and the tradeoffs in each search.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 10+ years of talent acquisition experience, including 5+ years leading a recruiting team.
* Experience building or rebuilding a recruiting function in a software or healthcare technology company of roughly 1,000 teammates.
* Hands-on leadership of an applicant tracking system (ATS) implementation from selection through go-live.
* Experience managing an RPO or agency program against defined service levels and budgets.
* Track record of reducing agency spend and cost per hire while hiring volume grew.
* Fluency with recruiting analytics, including funnel, quality of hire, source of hire, and time-to-fill reporting.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience running the A Method, Topgrading, or a comparable structured hiring method across a company.
* Dayforce Recruiting experience.
* Experience in a private equity-backed company, carve-out, or other rapid-growth environment.
* Experience building an employer brand and employee value proposition from the ground up.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

In your first 12 months, success in this role will look like:

* Every open role is in a hiring forecast tied to the value creation plan, roles are filled within the days-to-fill estimate for their type, and hiring manager and candidate satisfaction are at 90% or above.
* The A Method is used for every hire, all hiring managers are trained, and the A Player hire rate is at 90% or above.
* Recruiting is live on Dayforce with every requisition in one system, and a monthly dashboard with quality and source of hire is shared with the executive team.
* Three to four internal recruiters are hired and productive, the RPO is meeting its service levels every quarter, and agency spend and cost per hire are within budget with an employer brand strategy approved and the careers page refreshed.

**Why Join MatrixCare?**
------------------------

At MatrixCare, we are committed to fostering a culture where teammates can grow their careers and make an impact on the healthcare industry. We offer opportunities to contribute to innovative solutions that help improve care delivery, while benefiting from a flexible and supportive work environment. Our teammate value proposition includes comprehensive health and wellness benefits, flexible time off, professional development opportunities, and a collaborative culture built on trust, innovation, and teamwork. By joining MatrixCare, you'll be part of a purpose-driven organization dedicated to advancing healthcare technology and creating an exceptional experience for both teammates and customers.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

$160,000 - $180,000

We are shaping the future at MatrixCare, and we recognize the need to build on and broaden our existing skills and continue to attract and retain the world's best talent. We work hard to offer holistic benefits packages, provide flexible work arrangements, cultivate a workforce culture that allows employees to grow personally and professionally, and deliver competitive salaries to our team members. This position qualifies for a comprehensive benefits package and individual pay decisions are based on a variety of factors, such as the candidate's geographic work location, relevant qualifications, work experience, and skills. At MatrixCare it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case.

**Work Environment / Location Expectations**
--------------------------------------------

* Remote (US)

**Equal Employment Opportunity / Legal Statements**
---------------------------------------------------

MatrixCare is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace where every individual is treated with respect and dignity. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, business needs, and performance, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are dedicated to providing equal access to opportunities and reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment and employment process, ensuring that all teammates can contribute, grow, and succeed in an environment where diverse perspectives are valued and encouraged.

**Job Details**

The Supply Chain Dock Operations Director Health System provides leadership for dock operations within the health system supply chain, ensuring safe, compliant, and efficient inbound and outbound freight execution that supports uninterrupted patient care. Directs dock labor planning, carrier coordination, scheduling, and throughput management while partnering with distribution, inventory, procurement, and clinical stakeholders to optimize end-to-end logistics performance. Establishes standardized processes, controls, and performance metrics to improve service levels, reduce delays, and strengthen operational resilience. Leads continuous improvement initiatives, technology enablement, and contingency planning to ensure consistent execution across sites.

**Job Description**

  
**Summary**  
The Supply Chain Dock Operations Director Health System provides leadership for dock operations within the health system supply chain, ensuring safe, compliant, and efficient inbound and outbound freight execution that supports uninterrupted patient care. Directs dock labor planning, carrier coordination, scheduling, and throughput management while partnering with distribution, inventory, procurement, and clinical stakeholders to optimize end-to-end logistics performance. Establishes standardized processes, controls, and performance metrics to improve service levels, reduce delays, and strengthen operational resilience. Leads continuous improvement initiatives, technology enablement, and contingency planning to ensure consistent execution across sites.
  
  
**Job Duties**

* Directs health system dock operations for inbound receiving and outbound shipping, including appointment scheduling, yard/dock flow, and coordination with carriers and internal distribution teams.
* Leads and develops dock leadership and frontline teams; establishes staffing models, training, performance expectations, and succession plans to meet service and safety goals.
* Defines and monitors dock performance KPIs (e.g., on-time arrivals, dwell time, unload/load productivity, damage rates, detention/chargebacks) and drives corrective actions to improve throughput and reliability.
* Ensures compliance with OSHA, DOT, hazardous materials handling, infection prevention, and health system policies; maintains audit readiness and implements corrective and preventive actions.
* Standardizes dock SOPs and controls for receiving accuracy, documentation, chain of custody, temperature-sensitive/sterile product handling, and exception management (shortages, overages, damages, returns).
* Partners with Supply Chain, Facilities, Security, and clinical stakeholders to mitigate risk, improve dock security, and ensure continuity plans for emergent deliveries, disruptions, and alternate routing.
* Collaborates with procurement, accounts payable, and item master/ERP teams to resolve receiving and invoice discrepancies and to improve procure-to-pay execution and data integrity.
* Leads continuous improvement and technology initiatives (e.g., dock scheduling tools, scanning/automation, WMS/ERP enhancements) to reduce waste, improve visibility, and lower total logistics cost.

  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business administration, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 7 years to 10 years of progressive experience in distribution, dock operations, warehousing, or transportation within a complex environment (healthcare preferred).
* 7 years of people leadership with expert-level knowledge of dock, shipping/receiving, and logistics procedures.
* Expert knowledge of dock operations, freight receiving/shipping controls, and healthcare logistics requirements, including handling of temperature-sensitive, sterile, and regulated products.
* Proven ability to lead multi-site teams through standardized work, performance management, and change management to achieve service, cost, and safety outcomes.
* Advanced analytical capability to define KPIs, interpret operational data, and implement corrective actions that improve throughput, accuracy, and carrier performance.
* Strong working knowledge of safety and regulatory compliance (e.g., OSHA, DOT) and the ability to maintain audit-ready documentation and processes.
* Proficiency with ERP/WMS and dock scheduling/visibility tools, with the ability to translate operational needs into system requirements and process improvements.
* Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills to align carriers, suppliers, distribution, procurement, finance, and clinical stakeholders on priorities and execution.

  
**Additional Qualifications**  
**Physical Demands**  
Lift and carry 25 lbs. frequent sitting/standing, frequent keyboard use, \*patient care providers may be required to perform activities specific to their role including kneeling, bending, squatting and performing CPR.
  
  
Job Description Disclaimer: This position description provides the major duties/responsibilities, requirements and working conditions for the position. It is intended to be an accurate reflection of the current position, however management reserves the right to revise or change as necessary to meet organizational needs. Other responsibilities may be assigned when circumstances require.

Workday Day (United States of America)

Thomas Jefferson University

901 Market Street, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, United States of America

Jefferson is more than 65,000 people strong, dedicated to providing the highest-quality, compassionate clinical care for patients; making our communities healthier and stronger; preparing tomorrow's professional leaders for 21st-century careers; and creating new knowledge through basic/programmatic, clinical and applied research. Thomas Jefferson University , home of Sidney Kimmel Medical College, Jefferson College of Nursing, and the Kanbar College of Design, Engineering and Commerce, dates back to 1824 and today comprises 10 colleges and three schools offering 200+ undergraduate and graduate programs to more than 8,300 students. Jefferson Health , nationally ranked as one of the top 15 not-for-profit health care systems in the country and the largest provider in the Philadelphia and Lehigh Valley areas, serves patients through millions of encounters each year at 32 hospitals campuses and more than 700 outpatient and urgent care locations throughout the region. 10561fe9e8e5354db6b7.title: Senior Director, Global Infrastructure Technology & Operations
10561fe9e8e5354db6b7.description:
**Career-defining. Life-changing.**

At iRhythm, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills and your career while impacting the lives of people around the world. iRhythm is shaping a future where everyone, everywhere can access the best possible cardiac health solutions. Every day, we collaborate, create, and constantly reimagine what’s possible. We think big and move fast, driven by our commitment to put patients first and improve lives. We need builders like you. Curious and innovative problem solvers looking for the chance to meaningfully shape the future of cardiac health, our company, and your career

**About This Role:**

The Senior Director, Global Infrastructure Technology & Operations will lead iRhythm’s enterprise infrastructure strategy, architecture, operations, and modernization across cloud, networking, data center and hardware, end-user computing, and security infrastructure. This role will ensure that iRhythm’s technology foundation is resilient, secure, compliant, and scalable enough to support 24/7 clinical operations, manufacturing, global commercial growth, and the company’s expanding data and AI capabilities. This senior leadership role combines executive leadership, hands-on technical depth, organizational development, financial stewardship, and close partnership with the Chief Data Officer and head of IT, CISO, Quality/Regulatory, Engineering, and business leaders. The role works hand in hand with the CISO: Security defines the requirements and provides oversight, while Infrastructure delivers and operates the platforms, controls, and services that enable the business.

**What You Will Be Doing**
==========================

**Strategy & Leadership**
-------------------------

* Define and execute a multi-year enterprise infrastructure strategy and roadmap aligned to iRhythm’s business, clinical, data, and AI objectives.
* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing infrastructure organization across cloud, network, operations, end-user services, and managed service partners.
* Establish infrastructure architecture standards, reference patterns, governance, and operating models across business units and geographies.
* Serve as the senior infrastructure advisor to executive leadership, translating strategy, risk, investment, and performance into business terms.

**Cloud Infrastructure**
------------------------

* Own the enterprise multi-cloud strategy across AWS, GCP, Azure, and Microsoft 365, including landing zones, account and project structure, identity integration, and guardrails.
* Lead cloud platform engineering using Infrastructure as Code, automation, infrastructure CI/CD, and policy-as-code.
* Drive FinOps practices, including cost visibility, optimization, reserved-capacity strategy, and chargeback/showback.
* Enable modern data and AI platforms—including Snowflake, enterprise AI and search platforms, and ML/GPU workloads—with secure, scalable, well-governed infrastructure and private connectivity patterns.
* Lead workload migration and modernization from on-premises environments to cloud where appropriate.

**Networking & Connectivity**
-----------------------------

* Own enterprise network architecture across corporate offices, clinical and IDTF sites, manufacturing facilities, data centers, and cloud environments, including LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, Wi-Fi, SASE, DNS, and load balancing.
* Design secure hybrid and multi-cloud connectivity using Direct Connect, Interconnect, private endpoints, VPN, and transit architectures.
* Implement network segmentation and isolation for manufacturing/OT and clinical environments in alignment with Zero Trust principles.
* Ensure high availability, performance monitoring, and capacity planning for mission-critical clinical and patient-facing services.

**Data Center, Hardware & End-User Computing**
----------------------------------------------

* Oversee on-premises and colocation data centers, compute, storage, backup, and virtualization platforms, including lifecycle management and rationalization.
* Own the hardware asset lifecycle, including procurement, standards, refresh cycles, and secure disposal.
* Lead end-user computing across endpoints, MDM, collaboration tools, service desk, and conference room technology to deliver a secure and productive employee experience.
* Support infrastructure for manufacturing sites and clinical operations, including device and equipment connectivity where applicable.
* **Security Infrastructure**
  ---------------------------
* Implement, operate, and maintain infrastructure security controls in alignment with the security strategy, policies, and standards set by the CISO.
* Own the day-to-day engineering and operation of network and platform security technologies such as firewalls, WAF, proxies/SASE, NAC, and VPN, with the CISO’s team defining requirements, configuration standards, and monitoring.
* Embed security by design across infrastructure through hardening baselines, secure configurations, and Infrastructure-as-Code guardrails.
* Own timely vulnerability remediation and patching across infrastructure assets, meeting SLAs defined by the Security team.
* Operate identity and directory infrastructure, including SSO, MFA, and directory services, in support of the CISO-led Zero Trust and identity roadmap.
* Partner with the CISO’s organization during security incidents by providing infrastructure expertise, containment, remediation, logs, telemetry, and integrations needed for detection and response.

**Compliance, Quality & Regulated Environments**
------------------------------------------------

* Ensure infrastructure meets applicable regulatory and compliance obligations, including FDA QMSR (21 CFR Part 820), 21 CFR Part 11, HIPAA/HITECH, SOC 2, ISO 13485, ISO 27001, GDPR/UK GDPR, and other international requirements.
* Partner with the CISO, Quality, and Regulatory teams to maintain infrastructure controls and evidence for audits, with Security owning the control framework and this role owning control execution for infrastructure.
* Support computer system validation (CSV/CSA) for GxP-relevant infrastructure, along with change control and audit readiness.
* Lead infrastructure responses during internal, customer, and regulatory audits.
* Protect patient health information through appropriate data residency, encryption, access controls, and logging.

**Resilience, Operations & Service Management**
-----------------------------------------------

* Own business continuity and disaster recovery for infrastructure, with defined RTO/RPO targets for clinical and business-critical systems and regular DR testing.
* Build observability, monitoring, and alerting practices using SRE principles, SLOs, and error budgets for critical services.
* Mature ITSM processes for incident, problem, change, and configuration management using ITIL-aligned practices and tools such as ServiceNow.
* Drive automation to reduce toil and improve reliability, speed, and consistency.

**Vendor & Financial Management**
---------------------------------

* Own the infrastructure budget across OpEx and CapEx, including forecasting, business cases, and cost optimization.
* Manage strategic vendor, cloud provider, telecom, and managed service relationships, including contract negotiation and performance management.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and make build, buy, or partner recommendations.

**Technology Environment**
==========================

Our environment spans enterprise infrastructure, cloud, networking, security, end-user computing, data, AI, and regulated clinical and manufacturing systems. Experience with every named technology is not required.

* Cloud and platform: AWS, GCP, Azure, Microsoft 365, landing zones, Terraform or similar Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, policy-as-code, containers, virtualization, and GPU infrastructure.
* Netorking and connectivity: LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, Wi-Fi, SASE, DNS, load balancing, Direct Connect, Interconnect, private endpoints, VPN, transit architectures, NAC, firewalls, and WAF.
* Data, AI, and analytics infrastructure: Snowflake, Databricks, enterprise AI and search platforms, ML/GPU workloads, private connectivity, and governed data products.
* Security and identity: SSO, MFA, directory services, Zero Trust, endpoint management, vulnerability management, security telemetry, logging, and incident response integrations.
* Operations and service management: observability, monitoring, SRE practices, SLOs, error budgets, backup and recovery, ServiceNow, ITIL, and disaster recovery testing.
* Enterprise integrations and ecosystems: Jira, Confluence, GitLab, Salesforce, QAD, Workday, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, and other business and clinical platforms.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* 15+ years of progressive experience in enterprise infrastructure, including 7+ years leading multi-disciplinary infrastructure teams at the director level or above.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Proven strength in ability to balance strategic vision with execution excellence, developing organizational capability while creating the capacity, accountability, and focus needed to consistently deliver on business and technology priorities.
* Deep hands-on and architectural expertise in at least one major cloud platform, preferably AWS and/or GCP, with experience running multi-cloud and hybrid environments.
* Strong background in enterprise networking and hands-on experience engineering and operating security infrastructure in partnership with a security organization.
* Proven experience operating infrastructure in a regulated industry such as medical devices, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, or financial services.
* Working knowledge of FDA regulations, including 21 CFR Part 11 and 21 CFR Part 820, as well as frameworks such as HIPAA, SOC 2, ISO 27001, and NIST CSF.
* Track record of leading large-scale transformation programs, including cloud migration, data center consolidation, network modernization, or comparable enterprise initiatives.
* Experience owning budgets of meaningful scale and managing strategic technology, cloud, telecom, and managed service vendors.
* Excellent executive communication and influencing skills and the ability to translate technical risk, resilience, and investment into business outcomes.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience in a medical device, digital health, or connected-device company supporting 24/7 clinical services.
* Experience supporting manufacturing or OT networks and familiarity with IEC 62443 or similar OT security practices.
* Familiarity with infrastructure for data and AI platforms, including Snowflake, Databricks, ML/GPU workloads, and enterprise AI tools.
* Global infrastructure experience across the United States, United Kingdom/Europe, and Asia-Pacific, including data residency requirements.
* Certifications such as AWS or GCP Professional Architect, CCIE/CCNP,
* MBA or advanced degree.

c0922debd17b2820a1fa.description:
**Senior Project Manager – Highway & Traffic**

**Camden, NJ, US**

French & Parrello Associates (FPA) is seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to join our growing Highway & Traffic Department in Camden, NJ. This is an exciting opportunity for an accomplished transportation engineering professional to lead complex projects, strengthen client relationships, guide multidisciplinary teams, and contribute to the continued growth of one of the Northeast’s fastest-growing engineering consulting firms.

Recognized year after year as one of NJBIZ’s Best Places to Work in New Jersey, FPA is committed to creating a culture where talented professionals are empowered to grow, collaborate, and succeed. In 2026, FPA was ranked #49 on Zweig’s Hot Firm List, recognizing the firm among the 100 fastest-growing AEC firms in the United States and Canada. Our continued growth is driven by our investment in our people, technical excellence, and commitment to delivering innovative solutions for the communities we serve.

The successful candidate will have extensive experience leading highway reconstruction, roadway safety, Complete Streets, intersection improvement, and pedestrian and bicycle facility projects for public agencies. Working closely with clients and project stakeholders, this individual will provide technical and strategic leadership, oversee all aspects of project delivery, and ensure compliance with applicable standards and agency requirements.

This role offers the opportunity to serve as Project Manager and Project Principal on significant transportation projects while helping shape the growth of FPA’s practice. The Senior Project Manager – Highway & Traffic will develop client relationships, mentor engineering staff, lead proposal efforts, and collaborate with department leadership on strategic planning and operational improvements.

**Highway & Traffic Engineering Expertise & Project Leadership**

FPA’s Highway & Traffic Department provides planning, design, permitting, and construction support services for transportation projects serving local, county, state, and federal agencies.

The Senior Project Manager – Highway & Traffic will lead multidisciplinary teams throughout the project lifecycle while overseeing technical deliverables, project performance, QA/QC, and client coordination. This role requires the technical expertise, leadership, and business development experience needed to deliver profitable projects, develop staff, and pursue new opportunities.

**Responsibilities**

* Serve as Project Manager and Project Principal on transportation engineering projects for local, county, state, and federal agencies.
* Lead multidisciplinary project teams in the planning, design, permitting, and construction support phases of transportation projects.
* Manage project scope, schedules, budgets, staffing requirements, and overall project performance to ensure successful delivery.
* Oversee the preparation of design plans, specifications, cost estimates, technical reports, and supporting documentation utilizing AutoCAD Civil 3D and MicroStation.
* Provide quality control reviews and ensure compliance with applicable local, state, and federal design standards and agency requirements.
* Coordinate with clients, regulatory agencies, utility companies, and other project stakeholders throughout project development.
* Serve as the primary client contact and maintain strong relationships with existing clients while identifying opportunities for additional services.
* Lead proposal development efforts, including preparation of technical approaches, scope of services, fee estimates, and project schedules.
* Support business development initiatives through networking, industry involvement, client engagement, and participation in professional organizations.
* Mentor, supervise, and develop engineering staff by assigning work, providing technical guidance, and supporting professional growth.
* Collaborate with department leadership on strategic planning, resource allocation, and operational improvements.
* Participate in project interviews, presentations, and marketing efforts to secure new business opportunities.
* Provide construction support services, including responses to contractor inquiries, shop drawing reviews, and field coordination as required.
* Monitor project financial performance and implement corrective actions when necessary to maintain project profitability.
* Stay current with evolving transportation design standards, regulations, and industry best practices.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or related field.
* Professional Engineer (PE) license in the State of New Jersey required.
* 12+ years of progressive transportation engineering experience with increasing project management responsibilities.
* Demonstrated experience managing roadway, highway, traffic, intersection, and transportation improvement projects.
* Strong knowledge of NJDOT, PennDOT, county, and municipal transportation design standards and procedures.
* Proficiency with AutoCAD Civil 3D and MicroStation design software.
* Proven experience managing project budgets, schedules, staffing, and client relationships.
* Experience leading proposal efforts and supporting business development activities.
* Strong leadership skills with experience mentoring and managing engineering staff.
* Knowledge of traffic engineering principles and transportation planning concepts preferred.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
* Active participation in professional organizations such as ASCE, ACEC, ITE, or similar.
* Experience managing NJDOT and/or PennDOT projects.
* Existing relationships with transportation agencies, counties, municipalities, and industry stakeholders throughout New Jersey and Pennsylvania.
* Experience serving as Engineer of Record on transportation infrastructure projects.
* Experience with Complete Streets, Vision Zero, pedestrian and bicycle facilities, traffic calming, and roadway safety improvement projects.

**Additional Information**

* Sponsorship for U.S. employment authorization is not available for this position.
* Relocation assistance is not available for this position.

Don't meet every qualification? At FPA, we recognize that great candidates bring diverse experiences and perspectives. If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every listed requirement, we encourage you to apply. Your experience may be exactly what we need for this role or another opportunity within our growing team.

**The FPA Difference**

Large firms offer scale. FPA offers opportunity.

For more than 50 years, French & Parrello Associates (FPA) has been delivering innovative engineering solutions that shape communities, improve infrastructure, and support regional growth. As an employee-owned, mid-sized engineering and consulting firm, FPA combines the technical capabilities and expertise of a larger organization with the collaboration, accessibility, and personal investment of a close-knit team.

At FPA, engineers are empowered to take ownership of their work, collaborate across disciplines, and experience the full project lifecycle. Your career is not defined by one task or limited to one area of expertise. Instead, you will have the opportunity to strengthen your technical skills, work alongside experienced professionals, contribute to meaningful infrastructure projects, and develop the experience needed to grow into future engineering leadership roles.

Our multidisciplinary approach allows team members to see the bigger picture, collaborate with experts across multiple disciplines, and understand how their work impacts the communities we serve. We invest in our people through mentorship, professional development, and opportunities for advancement because we believe the success of our employees drives the continued success of our firm.

At FPA, you are not just designing infrastructure, you are helping build a growing organization while contributing to projects that make a lasting impact.

**Benefits**

Benefit packages for this role will start on the 1st day of employment and include medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as HSA, FSA, and DCFSA account options, and 401k retirement plans. Employees in this role are also entitled to paid sick leave and/or other paid time off as provided by applicable law.

**Compensation**

The projected compensation range for this position is $120,000 to $185,000. Actual compensation will depend on factors including experience, education, qualifications, and skill set. FPA recognizes and rewards performance through an annual bonus program.

d06935bf1523772866ca.title: Director, People Operations & Total Rewards
d06935bf1523772866ca.description:
Pie's mission is to empower small businesses to thrive by making commercial insurance affordable and as easy as pie. We leverage technology to transform how small businesses buy and experience commercial insurance.

Like our small business customers, we are a diverse team of builders, dreamers, and entrepreneurs who are driven by core values and operating principles that guide every decision we make.

With approximately 350 team members today and scaling through people and technology for the future, Pie is seeking an exceptional Director of People Operations & Total Rewards (Dir, POps & TR) to join the People leadership team. This role will shape and elevate our human resources function at a strategic level through AI, technology, and a blend of business- and people-centered approaches.

The Dir, POps & TR reports to the Chief People Officer (CPO). This Director role serves as a critical member of the People, Talent & Executive Support (PTE) leadership team, partnering directly with the CPO to co-develop and drive people operations, total rewards and technology strategies. The Director is accountable for the team member lifecycle delivery and experience from pre-hire through retire and supporting the alumnae experience. With this broad-reaching responsibility, the Director provides the structure, data, and analysis necessary for Pie's leaders and People, Talent and Executive Operations teams to execute against Pie's people-driven strategies. Given the breadth of responsibilities, this position will align with and influence multiple centers of excellence across the organization — including business intelligence, finance, analytics, and culture ambassadorship.

The Dir, POps & TR will own the development and execution of 12+ month strategies that shape functional direction and inform broader people strategy, aligned to company objectives. This role has three core pillars of ownership: People Operations, Total Rewards, and PTE Technology. Within these pillars, the Director is responsible for: people operations and tech strategy co-development with the CPO; payroll management; Total Rewards strategy and administration, including compensation, benefits, equity and leave programs — with a Total Rewards expert executing under their leadership; strategic ownership and governance of the People, Talent and Exec Operations technology stack with a strong focus on AI and automation; Workday configuration, maintenance, and data integrity; People workflow, process design and SOP management; reporting and analytics; contractor program oversight and reporting, and compliance. The role is also expected to partner closely with the Dir, Talent to support Talent Operations and the Manager of EA team to support Executive Operations. Aligning all of these areas around cohesive strategies that connect to Pie's goals and competitive differentiation will be key to our collective success.

The right person for this role is restless about improvement — not just executing the function, but continuously evolving it. They bring fresh eyes and a bias for experimentation to People Operations, and as a natural side effect of how they operate, they will contribute to making adjacent People team functions better as well. This cross-functional lift isn't their core responsibility, but it is a hallmark of the leader we're looking for.

### **How You'll Do It**

**Strategic Leadership, Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Design and sustain an innovative, effective, and inclusive work culture that retains and grows the best talent for the People Team and Pie as an organization
* Directly manage the People and Talent Operations team, currently comprised of four full-time team members with varying levels of experience and responsibility and which is expected to grow as the business demands
* Continuously improve the People Operations function — not just maintaining what exists, but actively evolving how the team operates, identifying what's not working, and leading the team to a better state over time
* Bring fresh perspective and a partnership mindset to adjacent People team functions; while not directly responsible for those areas, contribute actively to their improvement through shared ideas, candid feedback, and collaborative experimentation
* Continuously uplevel thought leadership specific to People Operations and Total Rewards, leveraging emerging frameworks, AI, and technologies to shape how the function operates
* Accountable for all aspects of people management across the team, including development, coaching, training, and performance management
* Proactively establish and maintain strong collaborative working relationships across the organization with a focus on the following stakeholders: Finance & Accounting, Enterprise Technology, Internal Communications, Legal & Compliance, Product, the Pie Executive Team, the Senior Leadership Team, and the Office of the CEO
* Serve as the strategic owner of Total Rewards at Pie, setting direction on compensation philosophy, benefits strategy, and equity administration; partner with the Total Rewards expert on execution and with Finance and Legal on governance
* Partner proactively with People Partners, Talent, and the Executive Support and Space teams on strategy development and outstanding execution across all aspects of the People, Talent & Exec Support functions
* Leveraging Pie's Collaboration and Decision Making Framework (CDMF), serve in a lead execution role, as well as supporting and consultative roles, on cross-functional, complex project and program management initiatives
* Lead across the organization as an AI champion and expert, freely sharing learnings and adaptable approaches with leaders and teams across the organization

**People Operations Management**

* Lead the People Operations team through strategic processes, projects, and complex situations; set the organizational standard for rigor, execution, and continuous improvement
* Design, deliver, and monitor the strategic roadmap for the People Operations function on a monthly, quarterly, and annual basis
* Oversee payroll approval for the biweekly pay cycle for non-exempt and exempt team members

**Tech Stack Management**

* Own the strategic design, delivery, and administration of our HRIS (Workday) and oversee the People tech stack and resources (Culture Amp, Continu, Ethena, Carta (shared), etc.) while driving AI solutions for faster and higher quality outcomes
* Manage the People Operations and Technology budget as well as People-specific vendor relationships and service providers
* Serve as the security admin for Workday, managing user and role-based security groups
* Own configuration, testing, and deployment updates, process improvements, and business process updates in HCM, Compensation, Advanced Compensation, Benefits, Time Tracking, Absence, US Payroll, and Talent
* Manage the bi-annual Workday release cycle
* Serve as the integration administrator to troubleshoot integration enhancements, issues, errors, or vendor requests

**Project & Program Management**

* Partner across the PTE team and key stakeholders organization-wide to identify and prioritize system development needs
* Align system configuration goals with PTE goals to optimize the HRIS' value
* Plan and execute moderate to complex projects, partnering with cross-functional SMEs
* Oversee Tier 1 team member support provided by the People Operations team
* Establish and maintain comprehensive documentation of process, workflow, system configuration, and integration
* Establish and train the team using best practice methods for People systems
* Lead, execute, contribute to and/or consult on projects, programs and work as needed

**Data Integrity, Management & Analysis**

* Monitor, audit, maintain, and troubleshoot the HRIS system to ensure data integrity and system compliance
* Maintain data integrity by developing routine audit procedures, creating audit reports, analyzing data, and defining corrective solutions
* Respond to requests for systems support and reports
* Develop data management protocols and standards, including data entry, integration, validation, and quality assurance procedures
* Establish and document audit procedures for the People Systems tech stack
* Ensure People Systems align with internal technology, procurement, and retention policies
* Build custom reports and dashboards for key metrics; fulfill ad-hoc report requests
* Analyze complex datasets to ensure system functionality and set-up

**Total Rewards Strategy & Administration**

* Own Total Rewards strategy at Pie, including compensation philosophy, benefits design, and equity administration; ensure the Total Rewards program is competitive, compliant, and aligned to Pie's mission and stage
* Lead the Total Rewards expert in day-to-day execution of compensation, benefits, and equity programs; serve as escalation point and strategic guide
* Partner with Finance on compensation modeling, headcount planning, and total rewards budgeting
* Manage external compensation and benefits vendors, consultants, invoices, and contracts
* Manage payroll contributions and 401(k) match processes
* Manage all total rewards-related reporting and maintain accuracy of compensation and benefits data
* Maintain systems to ensure accuracy of compensation data, job profiles, bonus targets, equity, and more
* Stay current on market benchmarking and compensation trends; translate insights into recommendations for Pie's leadership

### **The Right Stuff**

**Experience**

* 12 or more years of progressive experience in People (HR) with 5+ years of experience across people operations, Total Rewards (compensation, benefits, and/or equity), and tech stack ownership (Workday required); experience in Tier 1 team member relations, payroll management, and regulatory and compliance management also required
* 5 or more years of direct people management experience, including building, developing, and leading teams to consistent achievement of excellent business outcomes
* Demonstrated track record of shaping functional strategy and influencing outcomes in partnership with senior and C-level stakeholders
* Prior experience preferred in a high-growth tech-forward environment with a mix of private and public company experience preferred
* + You know what great looks like in a 400 to 5,000-person company and can also thrive in an earlier-stage environment that requires flexibility and building tools and resources, sometimes from scratch
* Prior experience in insurance, insurtech, fintech, healthtech, lending, or tech preferred
* Workday certification(s) preferred
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required

**Knowledge & Capabilities**

* Deep knowledge of HR workflow, regulatory, and compliance requirements across the employee lifecycle, with the capability to develop rigorous, highly efficient, compliant workflows, processes, and standard operating procedures
* Strong working knowledge of Total Rewards design and administration — including compensation structures, benefits programs, and equity plans — with the ability to translate market data and business needs into competitive, sustainable programs
* Demonstrated capability of developing, testing, and implementing tech- and AI-enabled solutions that create a flywheel of continuous improvement for the team and company, both independently and with stakeholders
* Demonstrated capability to plan and execute HR transformation and/or system implementation projects leveraging agile and iterative methodologies
* Outstanding technical and analytical capabilities with specific experience in People (HR), Talent and organizational technology, metrics, reporting, and data visualization
* Has the knowledge, and cultivates the relationships, necessary to provide thoughtful insights on market trends, best practices, and benchmarking — and to translate those insights into functional strategy

**Expected Competencies**

* **Ownership:** Demonstrates extreme ownership and a one-team mindset — We Are The They — modeling this across the function and with cross-functional leadership partners
* **Collaboration & Influence:** Builds high-trust relationships across the organization; works collaboratively with cross-functional stakeholders to identify and consider a wide range of needs, designing solutions that solve for the most needs at functional scale
* **Critical Thinking:** Leverages first principles, integrative thinking, and Pie's CDMF to design data-driven, maximum win/win solutions that consider all stakeholder needs
* **Strategy:** Develops 12+ month functional strategies and aligns teams and cross-functional partners around cohesive strategic narratives; cultivates internal and external networks for identifying emerging opportunities; identifies systemic inefficiencies and drives toward better outcomes
* **Growth Mindset:** Leads with questions and curiosity; demonstrates self-awareness and humility; models continuous learning and growth through integration of personal, team, and cross-functional feedback; recognizes when behavior or thinking is below the line and actively works to uplevel self and the team
* **Grit & Resilience:** Persists through complex challenges while role modeling resiliency and supporting team members and peers across the function
* **Communication:** Writes and speaks with accuracy, clarity, and confidence with audiences at all levels of the company, including the CEO and Senior Leadership Team; demonstrates emotional control and role models Pie's communication and feedback model; engages in constructive debate while actively listening; seeks and receives real-time candid feedback with kindness and positive intent
* **Execution:** Sets and maintains high standards for performance and execution that grow with the function and the business; flexes between strategic birds-eye view and tactical operational detail; fosters a culture of high accountability across the team and function, leading by example
* **Team Organization & Planning:** Designs organizational structures that address business needs and team effectiveness; develops operational rhythms that ensure functional and cross-functional alignment; builds monitoring systems that reduce complexity and provide real-time visibility into performance while enabling risk identification
* **Team Building & Performance Management:** Builds and executes talent strategies to enable the function to achieve and maintain a high level of performance; sets and measures against clear expectations at the individual and team level on a monthly, quarterly, and bi-annual basis

**The use of AI in Application Review:** To support a fair, efficient, and consistent hiring process, we use AI-powered tools to assist in the initial screening of applications. These tools help us identify qualifications and prior work experiences that align with the requirements of the role. We may also use AI assistant video tools during interviews to support note-taking and candidate evaluation. All AI-powered outputs are still subject to human oversight and decision-making at multiple stages of the process. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and consent to Pie utilizing these AI technologies to assist in our evaluation process.

### **Compensation & Benefits**

* Competitive cash compensation
* Comprehensive health plans
* Generous PTO
* Future focused 401k match
* Generous parental and caregiver leave
* Our core values are more than just a poster on the wall; they're tangibly reflected in our work

**Making every part of working with us "Easy as Pie"** - including our offer process. When we find someone we'd like as a Pie-oneer (a member of our team), we move quickly to put together a fair offer based on your skills, experience, location, and compensation expectations.

Each year Pie reviews company performance and may grant discretionary bonuses to eligible team members.

### **Location Information**

Unless otherwise specified, this role is remote. Remote team members must live and work in the United States (*territories excluded*) and have access to reliable, high-speed internet.

### **Additional Information**

*Pie Insurance is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, national or ethnic origin, military service status, citizenship, or other protected characteristic.*

Little Gay Book is a high-end professional matchmaking service dedicated to supporting and uplifting the LGBTQ+ community. We offer personalized matchmaking, speed dating events, coaching, and community-focused gatherings that foster meaningful connections. We create inclusive, welcoming spaces where people can meet, learn, and grow in their relationships and social lives.

Our sister company, **Little Black Book**, is a bespoke, high-touch matchmaking service for discerning heterosexual professionals.

Our team works in a mission-driven environment that values authenticity, respect, and community-building.

**The Role**

We are looking for an experienced***Enrollment Director/Sales***to lead membership enrollment for both Little Gay Book and Little Black Book. You will engage prospective clients, explain our matchmaking services, and guide people through enrollment with professionalism and care. You will turn new and existing leads into members, build lasting client relationships, and work closely with our matchmaking and events teams so every client has a great experience.

This role drives revenue while representing our values of inclusion, integrity, and care.

* Write detailed client discovery notes in the database to support the service team
* Complete weekly and monthly reports
* Track and manage payments on sales as needed

* *All Team Meetings and Matchmaker Meetings*

4caac46cb82149aba03a.title: Director, Integrated Marketing (USA)
4caac46cb82149aba03a.description:
### **Who we are:**

Creyos (formerly Cambridge Brain Sciences) is a leading growth-stage B2B SaaS HealthTech company. Our proprietary digital cognitive assessment tools, including digital cognitive tasks and electronic behavioral health questionnaires, are used by healthcare providers treating mental health conditions, brain injuries, aging, and other patient populations throughout the world, as well as by leading researchers. You will be part of a team that includes not just your typical SaaS business functions (Sales, Marketing, Customer Success), but also engineers, psychologists, business leaders, and even a world-renowned neuroscientist

### **Who we are looking for:**

We’re seeking a Director of Integrated Marketing to build the engine behind our growth. The ideal candidate has experience in both SMB and enterprise marketing and has built winning demand generation programs from the ground up—equally comfortable crafting account-based marketing (ABM) strategies as they are launching and optimizing hands-on, multi-channel campaigns. You appreciate the complexity of healthcare, including long sales cycles and buying committees spanning clinical, operational, and executive stakeholders. You are energized by building relationships with key stakeholders, advancing opportunities, and inspiring action.

You are a player-coach. You know when to set the strategy and when to write the brief yourself, challenge the message, and review the work. You’ve led multidisciplinary marketers before and raised their game, not just their output. You’re comfortable deciding with imperfect information and building a repeatable process where little exists yet.

Please note that this is a **remote** opportunity based in the **United** **States**.

### **What you will be doing:**

As a Director, Integrated Marketing at Creyos, you will:

**Enterprise Marketing & Account-Based Marketing**

* Help build and lead our enterprise and ABM strategy with the CMO, Sales leadership, and Revenue Operations.
* Develop a tiered ABM model — one-to-one for strategic accounts, one-to-few for account clusters, one-to-many for broader segments — with clear target-account criteria and success measures.
* Create repeatable account plays Sales and Marketing activate together, measured on account progression and opportunity creation rather than impressions and clicks.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop team members across demand generation and field marketing, helping them gain new experiences and elevate competencies.
* Set clear priorities, ownership, and performance expectations, and address gaps directly and fairly.
* Introduce the frameworks and coaching that let the team execute high-quality campaigns independently.

**Integrated Campaign Leadership**

* Lead campaigns end to end: business objective, audience insight, message, creative, activation, and optimization.
* Write the briefs that align messaging, content, creative, channels, Sales participation, timelines, and metrics.
* Sharpen segmentation and targeting for professional and mid-market programs, moving demand generation from broad tactics to focused, insight-led campaigns.

**Customer Marketing & Retention**

* Partner with Account Management, Sales, and Product on lifecycle programs supporting product engagement, renewal, advocacy, and expansion.
* Support GTM strategies for new feature launches, developing communication and advertising plans to promote early excitement and adoption.

**Messaging & Creative Direction**

* Partner with the CMO to continually elevate the clarity and differentiation of our messaging, grounding it in customer problems and outcomes rather than product features.
* Give specific, actionable feedback to team members on concepts, writing, design, and sales materials that materially improves the work.

**Planning, Performance & Optimization**

* Own the marketing campaign calendar and a consistent cadence for planning, briefing, launch readiness, and post-campaign review.
* Report on performance across SMB and enterprise segments, including target-account engagement, lead progression, opportunity creation, pipeline value, and closed-won business.
* Partner with Revenue Operations to improve reporting and attribution, and use results to improve the next program.

### **The skills and experience we are looking for:**

* 8+ years of progressive B2B marketing experience, ideally in high-growth SaaS and specifically HealthTech.
* 4+ years leading teams or complex cross-functional marketing programs.
* Demonstrated success building enterprise and ABM programs across one-to-one, one-to-few, and one-to-many motions.
* Proven ability to connect ABM activity to account progression, pipeline, revenue, or expansion.
* Experience marketing to enterprise buying committees through long, complex sales cycles.
* Strong integrated campaign development and project management across multiple channels and functions.
* Exceptional messaging, writing, editing, creative briefing, and presentation skills, with the ability to tailor tone, framing, and content to the audience and desired outcome.
* A close working history with Sales, account management, and Revenue Operations.
* Experience coaching marketers at varying levels of capability and independence.
* Comfortable in a growth-stage, resource-constrained environment — resourceful, decisive, and low ego.
* Familiarity with Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Analytics, and other MarTech platforms.

### **Some of the reasons people choose to join the Creyos team include:**

* Get access to comprehensive benefits. We pride ourselves on offering benefits covering medical, dental, vision, mental health, wellness and more.
* Grow through our career paths leading to more senior roles. We invest in the development of our team members, provide significant opportunities for growth and career advancement, and do everything we can to support one another to ensure individual and team success. We regularly promote team members to more senior roles.
* Recharge during our annual company-wide break and extra holidays. In addition to vacation and quarterly Personal Days, every year we take a company-wide break in December to rest and recharge. We also give team members two additional holidays off per year: U.S. Independence Day and U.S. Thanksgiving, which we celebrate as Brain Holidays. We want you to feel motivated and energized at work!

### **Additional information:**

Creyos uses an AI-powered tool as part of an automated process to support our hiring process by analyzing your experience, skills, and qualifications to help identify alignment with role requirements. These tools also assist with administrative tasks such as calendar invites, note-taking and documentation to ensure we can focus more fully on our conversations with you. Because AI-generated documentation occasionally contains inaccuracies or omissions, our team uses this as secondary, supportive reference only. Please note that the tool does not make final decisions or automatically disqualify candidates. Hiring decisions are made by our team, with thoughtful human judgment and oversight. We are committed to fair and transparent hiring practices and have implemented safeguards to help mitigate bias and support compliance with applicable laws. By proceeding with your application, you understand that these administrative tools are used to support our team’s evaluation and documentation process.

Please Note: This posting is for an existing open vacancy at the company.

*Creyos is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and disability, or another legally protected status. We are committed to providing employment accommodation in accordance with the Ontario Human Rights Code and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act, 2005 (AODA). Creyos will provide accommodations to job applicants with disabilities throughout the recruitment process. If you require accommodation, please notify our Talent Acquisition Manager directly and we will work with you to meet your needs.*

**We Are:**

Accenture helps the world's leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. **You Are:**

We are seeking a Program Delivery Consultant to support complex technology programs for our healthcare clients. You are a hands-on problem solver who combines strong analytical, communication, and delivery skills with an understanding of healthcare payer operations and technology-enabled transformation.

You have experience working within cross-functional teams to develop high-quality deliverables, coordinate delivery activities, analyze business and technology challenges, and help move programs from planning through implementation.

  

You are organized, detail-oriented, comfortable managing multiple priorities, and able to communicate effectively with both client and Accenture team members.

As an Accenture Consultant, you will work closely with Managers, Senior Managers, and client stakeholders to support program execution, create client-ready deliverables, address delivery challenges, and contribute to a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing team environment.

d5d881390c2e97b1ffcc.description:
Our Work Matters
  
At Kindeva we make products that save lives, ensuring better health and well-being for patients around the world.
  
  
The Impact You Will Make
  
The Director of Sales for Kindeva Drug Delivery (KDD) will lead the development of Kindeva new business opportunity and growth. The role will be responsible for uncovering new sales opportunities for Kindeva’s entire enterprise suite of services and product offering, primarily injectable drug delivery, but also including nasal drug delivery, dermal drug delivery and analytical services.
  
The Director of Sales is recognized as an influential leader, partnering with executive leadership team to provide cohesive direction towards business development goals for Sterile Injectables, uncovering, developing, and winning new sales demand in line with Kindeva’s growth objectives. This role requires building and maintaining strong client relationships at all levels, ensuring existing client needs are met, and driving ongoing business by identifying opportunities to upsell, cross-sell, and renew contracts, essentially acting as a liaison between Kindeva and our clients to foster long-term partnerships.
  
  
**Essential Job Functions:**  

* This role is accountable for results in a dynamic and fast-paced environment to drive sales volume and profitable revenue across our enterprise services and product offering with emphasis on Sterile Injectables manufacturing.
* Responsibility for the development, maintenance and continuous improvement of sales strategy, vision and direction, delivering actionable key new business plans.
* This individual has the ability to generate business for clinical and late phase GMP manufacturing for the new state of the art Bridgeton sterile injectables site, as well as early analytical, formulation and process development for select platforms. Candidate should have demonstrated ability to uncover and grow customer relationships with virtual, small, mid-large pharma, specialty and generic pharmaceutical companies.
* Works to identify effective market segments and drive creation of prospective client target lists supporting new business objectives.
* Lead communication, interacting with internal and external executive level management, requiring negotiation of extremely critical matters relative to KDD offerings, services and value propositions, convincing potential customers to select KDD as their outsourced development and manufacturing partner of choice.
* Lead negotiations for the contracting of KDD development and manufacturing services with partners. Anticipates factors that could influence strategies and current and long-term company position in the market.
* Reporting directly to KDDs VP and Head of Business Development, this role will act as the sales leader for growth strategy.

**Basic Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution
* 8+ years of sales, business development, or key account management experience in the pharmaceutical or CDMO industry, with a proven record of driving revenue growth.
* Demonstrated experience in enterprise-level contract negotiations for clinical and commercial manufacturing supply agreements.
* In-depth knowledge of pharmaceutical development and manufacturing processes, with a focus on injectable product development and GMP manufacturing.
* Proven ability to develop and lead high-impact sales strategies that drive growth across diverse market segments.
* Strong leadership skills, with a history of managing cross-functional teams and influencing key stakeholders at all levels.
* Expertise in using Salesforce.com or other CRM systems to track and manage sales pipelines effectively.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills, with a results-oriented approach.

**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Advanced degree in business, life sciences, or related fields

470dacdb3cc4bcc332f5.title: Project Coordinator
470dacdb3cc4bcc332f5.description:
Exante360, Inc., is looking for a Project Coordinator that wants to join us on our bold initiative of “improving lives through relationships, by connecting people to solutions.”

**Role**  
The Project Coordinator supports the successful execution of projects by managing and tracking project tasks, schedules, scopes, and workloads through the entire project lifecycle. Working closely with Project Managers and cross‑functional teams, the Project Coordinator uses tools such as the typical suite of Microsoft products (Outlook, Office, Teams, SharePoint), but also PM focused tools like Asana and Procore to provide accurate project visibility and support delivery against schedule, budget, and quality objectives.

Exante360 is building an AI-forward organization. We are looking for professionals who embrace artificial intelligence, automation, and digital transformation as part of how they work. Ideal candidates are proactive in learning and applying new technologies, comfortable integrating AI tools into their workflow where appropriate, and capable of combining technology with sound business judgment to deliver exceptional results.

**What You’ll Do**

* Support project setup and mobilization across Project Management, Design, BIM, and Administrative teams, ensuring smooth cross‑functional coordination from project start through closeout.
* Partner with multiple Project Managers to help develop and maintain project schedules, plans, and milestone tracking to support on‑time delivery.
* Configure and maintain project frameworks in Asana, tailoring templates and workflows to meet unique project requirements and prioritize tasks and deliverables.
* Work with Project Managers to translate budgeted hours into clearly defined, assigned project tasks.
* Maintain accurate, up‑to‑date project data to support weekly coordination meetings and informed decision‑making.
* Develop and manage project look‑ahead schedules throughout the lifecycle of assigned projects.
* Participate in regular check‑ins with Project Managers to track risks, issues, and action items, and ensure timely follow‑up.
* Coordinate with external stakeholders as needed to support timely completion of project milestones.
* Monitor project budgets against actual expenditures and flag variances or concerns to the Project Manager.
* Assist with earned value tracking and reporting for assigned projects.
* Coordinate and administer change orders, Additional Service Requests (ASRs), and other contract modifications for Project Manager review and approval.
* Maintain organized electronic project files, including document control, submittal and RFI logs, and QA/QC documentation.
* Prepare and distribute project reports, dashboards, meeting minutes, and action items trackers to keep teams informed and aligned.
* Keep detailed records of project activities, changes, and documentation to support transparency and accountability.
* Contribute to the development and improvement of company standards, templates, and processes related to project management, communication, and administration.

**Sample Tasks You’ll Perform**

* **Set up and manage project schedules in a project management platform** by configuring project templates, assigning tasks based on budgeted hours, and maintaining look‑ahead schedules to support weekly PM coordination.
* **Track project financials and changes** by monitoring budget vs. actuals, assisting with earned value tracking, and coordinating change orders and Additional Service Requests (ASRs) for Project Manager review.
* **Prepare and maintain project documentation and reporting** by keeping organized electronic files, updating submittal/RFI logs, and assembling dashboards, meeting minutes, and action item summaries for internal and external stakeholders.

**Key Skills and Abilities Necessary**

* Possesses anticipation and scheduling skills, ability to efficiently and effectively plan workloads
* Ability to quickly adapt to project changes with limited notice.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Sense of responsibility, customer service, excellence, and versatility.
* Self-motivated and takes initiative without waiting for direction
* Excellent time management skills
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Exceptional follow-through and follow-up skills

**Education/Experience Requirements**

* 3+ years of construction or administrative experience required.
* Demonstrated proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools for project documentation, reporting, data tracking, scheduling, and collaboration across cross-functional teams.
* Experience within the A/E/C industry preferred.
* Prior experience with Asana experience preferred.
* Certifications such as Project Management Institute CAPM or PMP preferred.
* Demonstrated experience using AI, automation, data analytics, or other emerging technologies to improve efficiency, decision-making, collaboration, or business outcomes.

**What We Offer**

We believe that the culture of the company, work environment, and job responsibilities present a unique working atmosphere in which you will thrive. We trust people to own their work, make smart decisions, and use the freedom they’re given to deliver exceptional results. We uphold superior customer service, strive for excellence, embrace versatility, and take responsibility in everything we do. Join a growing team that’s shaping an exciting, fast-evolving industry and pushing the boundaries of what’s possible!

We’re proud to offer an experience that not only makes work more enjoyable, but also empowers you to grow, stay energized, and feel supported every step of the way.

* Remote work environment built on intentional connection
* Professional growth through prioritizing your continued education goals
* Robust benefit package to support wellness and work life balance

**Who We Are**

Exante360, Inc. is an industry-leading technology design and consulting company that specializes in Information and Communications Technology (ICT) and Security systems. Guided by our Core Values, our certified professionals consult, design, and manage a variety of specialized low-voltage systems including telecommunications and data network cabling infrastructure, wireless (Wi-Fi, DAS, ERCES), electronic security systems (access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, security communications), audiovisual, fire alarm, nurse call, clinical communications, and other technology systems. Since our founding in 2013, our company has successfully completed thousands of technology design projects in various market sectors, including healthcare, education, data centers, critical infrastructure, corporate, government, biotech, and transportation. Our services include project management and construction administration to ensure that our projects effectively produce Intended Results.

Job Type: Full-time

**Benefits:**

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program
* Vision insurance
* Long Term Disability Insurance

Work Location: Remote

ac693811ead29cef054e.description:
**We're not just behavioral health people—we're crisis people.**

Connections Health Solutions is a leading provider of immediate-access behavioral health crisis care. Our team combines medical and recovery-oriented treatment to stabilize individuals in crisis and connect them to community-based resources for ongoing recovery.

Founded by emergency room psychiatrists Dr. Chris Carson and Dr. Robert Williamson, our model is physician-led and data-driven, drawing upon more than 15 years of crisis care expertise. Recognized by SAMHSA and the National Council for Mental Wellbeing as a national best practice, we've delivered invaluable treatment to hundreds of thousands of individuals facing crises. Our commitment remains consistent, to improve access, inspire hope, and provide the right support.

Our values shape our decisions, define our culture, and foster continuous learning and growth.

We accept people as they are, creating safe spaces where they feel valued and respected. We inspire hope by walking with people side-by-side, showing them grace and compassion. We act with intention, holding ourselves and each other accountable, and doing the right thing. We work as one team, trusting and supporting each other. We embrace change and innovation, striving to find better ways to fulfill our mission.

We are on a mission to change the face of behavioral health. Help us save lives and make a difference.

  

**What You'll Do:**

The **HR Coordinator** provides administrative and operational support across the People function, helping ensure HR processes are organized, accurate, timely, and responsive. This part-time position supports day-to-day HR administration, employee records, benefits and leave activities, compliance documentation, and People team programs and projects.

The HR Coordinator serves as a resource for routine team member questions and requests, maintains accurate and confidential employee information, and partners with HR Business Partners and other People team members to coordinate follow-up and complete administrative activities. The position requires strong organization, attention to detail, customer service, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**HR Operations & Administrative Support**

* Provide day-to-day administrative and operational support across the People function

* Responds to routine team member questions and requests and directs or escalates more complex matters to appropriate People team member

* Provides administrative support for shared HR inboxes

* Provides timely replies to employment verification requests

* Supports HR Business partners and other People team members with administrative requests, documentation, tracking and follow-up

* Provides administrative coordination support for People programs, initiatives, and special projects under the direction of HR leadership
* Provides back-up coverage with onboarding new hires

**Benefits, Leaves, & Workers Compensation Support**

* Provides administrative support to the Benefits Administrator for benefits, leaves, and workers' compensation activities

* Provide backup coverage to the Benefit Administrator during peak periods, absences, or as workload requires

* Assist with answering basic questions and escalates as appropriate for timely follow up
* Assist with annual benefits activities and other benefit-related initiatives

**Compliance Records & Support**

* Partners with HR Business Partners (HRBPs) to proactively review employee files and records for completeness and compliance

* Partners with center HR to assist with any records audit related to a regulatory visit

* Maintains confidentiality regarding all employee records.

* Follows up with requests for information from government, licensing or regulatory entities such as unemployment claims, and validation of worked hours

**People Projects & Initiatives**

* Provides administrative and coordination support for seasonal and special People projects under the direction of HR leadership.

* Supports activities related to new market and center openings, annual enrollment, employee engagement initiatives, audits, and other People programs.Assists with project tracking, scheduling, documentation, communications, and follow-up as assigned.
* Provides additional administrative support across the People function based on business needs and priorities.

**This is a part-time position, averaging 20 hours/week.**

**This is a fully remote position in these states:** **AL, AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MT, NC, NJ, NY, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, VA, WA, WI**

**What You'll Bring:**

* 2 years of Human Resources experience
* Strong oral and written communication skills
* Familiarity with benefits rules and regulations
* Ability to work professionally with a diverse range of individuals
* **The Company has a mandatory vaccination policy. All successful applicants must be fully vaccinated, including showing proper documentation, or otherwise be exempt pursuant to the Company's exemption process prior to their start date as a condition of employment**

**It would be great if you had:**

* Work experience in the healthcare industry
* Familiarity with HRIS platforms
* Experience with employment law, benefits, leave and workers compensation

**What We Offer:**

  

Full-time only:

* Employees (and their families) are offered comprehensive health insurance, including Medical, Dental, Vision, Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity
* CHS pays for Basic Life, AD&D, Short and Long-Term Disability
* Voluntary Life insurance option for employees and their families
* Health Savings Accounts (with $1,000 to $2,000 employer contribution depending on plan)
* Flexible Spending Accounts (health care and dependent care)
* 401k company match after 6 months (50% of deferrals up to 6% of compensation)
* Generous PTO starting at 160 hours accrued annually and 12 recognized company holidays
* Company‑paid parental leave available to eligible employees

All employees (Pool, Part-time and Full-time):

* Employee Assistance Program to help with confidential emotional support, work life solutions, financial solutions, legal assistance, or online support
* After 90 days, you are auto enrolled in the 401k Plan

-----------------

We are committed to creating an inclusive and welcoming environment for all employees and applicants.

Please note:
