37b3ae05e5d9a7cc3c46.title: Marketing Manager
37b3ae05e5d9a7cc3c46.description:
**Job Title:**  
Marketing Manager
  
  
**Location:**  
Remote (U.S. based)
  
  
FLSA Classification
  
  
Exempt
  
  
**Job Description:**  
Orbital is seeking a strategic, creative, and hands-on Marketing Manager to lead the company’s marketing and communications efforts and manage a team of marketing professionals. This position will play an important role in strengthening Orbital’s brand, increasing market visibility, supporting business development, and promoting the company’s people, capabilities, and projects.
  
  
The Marketing Manager will oversee day-to-day marketing activities while working closely with executive leadership, business development, and operational leaders to develop and execute marketing strategies aligned with Orbital’s growth objectives. This position will have direct responsibility for members of the marketing team and will coordinate internal resources and external partners to deliver high-quality marketing initiatives.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a strong communicator and project manager who can develop a strategy, lead a team, manage multiple initiatives, and remain hands-on in execution.
  
  
This role reports to the President and the Chief Legal Officer of the organization.
  
  
Essential Functions
  
  

* Lead and manage Orbital’s marketing team, including setting priorities, assigning responsibilities, developing team members, and ensuring timely and high-quality execution.
* Develop and execute Orbital’s annual marketing and communications plan in alignment with company growth objectives.
* Manage and strengthen Orbital’s brand, messaging, and market positioning across all platforms and communications.
* Manage the company website, including content, functionality, user experience, analytics, and ongoing optimization.
* Develop and execute a comprehensive SEO strategy to improve organic search visibility, website traffic, and qualified business opportunities.
* Lead Orbital’s social media strategy, with a primary focus on LinkedIn and other relevant B2B platforms.
* Manage and develop the LinkedIn profiles and thought-leadership strategies of multiple Orbital executives and senior leaders.
* Work directly with executives and subject matter experts to develop industry insights, articles, posts, presentations, and other thought-leadership content.
* Develop and manage integrated marketing campaigns supporting strategic markets, service lines, clients, and business-development initiatives.
* Partner with Business Development and operational leaders to develop marketing materials, case studies, project profiles, presentations, proposals, and client-facing content.
* Develop and maintain a company-wide content strategy and editorial calendar.
* Lead Orbital’s conference, trade show, sponsorship, and industry event strategy, including planning, logistics, booth design, promotional materials, executive participation, and post-event follow-up.
* Identify opportunities for Orbital executives and subject matter experts to participate in industry conferences, panels, podcasts, interviews, and speaking engagements.
* Develop and manage Orbital’s public relations and media strategy, including press releases, industry publications, media opportunities, and company announcements.
* Lead the company’s awards and recognition strategy, including identifying opportunities and managing submissions.
* Manage company promotional items, branded merchandise, signage, trade show materials, and other brand assets.
* Develop corporate communications supporting major company announcements, organizational initiatives, acquisitions, strategic priorities, and company milestones.
* Partner with Human Resources and executive leadership on internal communications, employee engagement, recruiting campaigns, and company-wide initiatives.
* Support executive leadership with presentations, biographies, talking points, speeches, and other communications.
* Establish and maintain marketing processes, standards, and best practices across the organization.
* Monitor marketing performance and provide regular reporting on website, SEO, social media, campaigns, events, and other key metrics.
* Identify and implement opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve marketing effectiveness and efficiency.
* Manage marketing vendors, agencies, budgets, and other external resources.
* Stay current on marketing, communications, SEO, social media, AI, and digital trends and identify opportunities to improve Orbital’s marketing capabilities.

Team Leadership
  
  

* Provide day-to-day leadership, direction, and support to the marketing team.
* Establish clear goals, priorities, responsibilities, and performance expectations for direct reports.
* Develop team members through coaching, feedback, training, and professional development.
* Ensure marketing resources are appropriately allocated across competing company priorities.
* Establish workflows and processes that improve efficiency, accountability, and quality.
* Foster a culture of creativity, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Coordinate workload and priorities across internal marketing resources and external vendors.
* Evaluate staffing and resource needs as the company’s marketing requirements evolve.

Other Duties
  
  
Please note that this job posting does not list all duties and responsibilities that are required of this job. Duties and responsibilities may change at any time with or without notice.
  
  
**Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Journalism, or a related field.
* 5+ years of progressive marketing and communications experience, preferably within engineering, consulting, construction, energy, utilities, industrial, or other B2B professional services environments.
* Previous experience managing or leading marketing professionals required.
* Demonstrated experience developing and executing comprehensive marketing strategies.
* Strong understanding of SEO, digital marketing, website management, social media, analytics, and content strategy.
* Experience managing executive social media profiles and developing thought-leadership content.
* Experience managing conferences, trade shows, sponsorships, and corporate events.
* Strong writing, editing, communication, and presentation skills.
* Experience working directly with executive leadership and senior business leaders.
* Ability to understand complex technical services and translate them into clear and compelling market-facing content.
* Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Experience with website content management systems, SEO platforms, social media platforms, analytics tools, and other marketing technologies.
* Experience using AI and emerging technologies to improve marketing processes and content development is preferred.

Key Attributes
  
  

* Strategic: Understands how marketing supports business growth and market positioning.
* Leader: Capable of building, developing, and motivating a high-performing marketing team.
* Hands-On: Willing and able to personally execute work when necessary.
* Creative: Brings new ideas and differentiated approaches to strengthen Orbital’s brand.
* Highly Organized: Effectively manages multiple initiatives, deadlines, events, and stakeholders.
* Excellent Communicator: Strong writer who can communicate effectively with executives, employees, clients, and industry audiences.
* Proactive: Identifies opportunities and takes initiative rather than waiting for direction.
* Business-Minded: Understands the relationship between marketing, business development, client relationships, and revenue growth.
* Data-Driven: Uses measurable results to evaluate and improve marketing effectiveness.
* Collaborative: Builds strong relationships across executive leadership, business development, operations, and technical teams.
* Technology-Oriented: Embraces modern digital marketing, SEO, AI, analytics, and automation.

**Location Note:**  
This is a remote position. Compensation is based on market data and internal equity and may vary depending on the candidate’s location.
  
  
**Salary Range:**  
$120,000-135,000 annually (based on experience, qualifications, and location)
  
  
**Benefits:**  
A commitment to excellence and hard work will be rewarded with a competitive salary, career advancement opportunities, and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance. Our benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage; a 401(k)-retirement savings plan; and supplemental insurance options. We also provide company-paid life and AD&D insurance, company-paid short-term disability coverage, company-paid maternity and bonding leave, and a generous paid time off program to ensure you have the support and flexibility you need both professionally and personally.
  
  
**About Orbital:**  
Powered by People, Driven by Solutions
  
  
Since 1969, Orbital has been specializing in project development, project execution and asset management for the heavy industrial sectors and utilities. Our regional offices, hands-on mentality, and world-wide integrated teams provide an ability to leverage subject matter experts and industry best-practices wherever a project may lie geographically. Our focus steadfastly remains on finding and delivering the best solution, regardless of where that team sits across our organization. At Orbital, our power is our people.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Statement:**  
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

This position is expected to contribute to and deliver business processes or detailed technology solutions, in a self-managed and target oriented manner, and thus contributes to team results.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Advanced Excel, Data Analysis & Auditing**

* Utilize **advanced Excel skills** to analyze employee data, perform audits, and automate recurring tasks to improve operational efficiency.
* Develop and maintain **Excel-based tools** to streamline People Data Services operations and identify trends, patterns, discrepancies, and opportunities for improvement within HR data.

**Data Quality & Integrity**

* Ensure the overall **quality, accuracy, integrity, and consistency of HR data** across systems.
* Identify data gaps, process inefficiencies, and business process issues that may compromise data integrity, and recommend or drive appropriate **system and process improvements**.
* Conduct regular data reviews and audits to proactively identify and resolve data quality issues.

**Process Improvement & Operational Excellence**

* Serve as a **Topic Owner and Subject Matter Expert (SME)** for one or more functional areas, such as Job Changes, Terminations, Global Mobility, or other HR processes.
* Ensure assigned functional topics, processes, and documentation remain **accurate, current, and aligned with established SLAs, KPIs, and procedures**.
* Lead cross-functional collaboration with teams such as **Payroll, Service Excellence, HR Solutions, and other HR partners** to improve end-to-end processes and maximize operational efficiency.
* Conduct regular training and knowledge-sharing sessions to ensure team members remain current on **DTPs, processes, system functionality, and system changes**.
* Review closed cases to ensure they are handled accurately and consistently in accordance with established **DTPs and SLAs**.
* Identify and provide recommendations for **continuous improvement and service enhancements** based on KPIs, customer feedback, operational trends, and best-practice sharing, with a focus on **standardization, automation, and simplification**.
* Provide **guidance, coaching, and day-to-day support** to team members as required.

**Workday System Experience**

* Serve as an **escalation point for complex Workday business processes and system-related issues** requiring in-depth analysis, evaluation of multiple factors, or specialized security access.
* Assess the implications of changes within **Workday and other HR systems**, including impacts to business processes, employee data, integrations, and downstream systems.
* Recommend and implement solutions to address complex system, process, and data issues while maintaining data integrity and operational effectiveness.

**ServiceNow System Experience**

* Monitor daily operations through the **ServiceNow dashboard**, ensuring workload and cases are distributed appropriately and as evenly as possible across the team.
* Monitor the functionality of cases and tasks to ensure they are operating as designed.
* Gather feedback from team members regarding case and task functionality, identify recurring issues or errors, and coordinate with the **Service Excellence and SHARP teams** to ensure issues are reported, investigated, and addressed in a timely manner.
* Proactively identify ServiceNow issues that could impact the team's daily operations and support appropriate resolution and process improvements.

**Skills**

* **Advanced Excel & Data Analysis** – Strong proficiency in Excel, including PivotTables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, CONCATENATE, DATEDIF, conditional formulas, and other advanced functions used for data analysis, reporting, and auditing.
* **HR Data Auditing & Reconciliation** – Strong ability to analyze, audit, and reconcile employee data to identify discrepancies and maintain data accuracy and integrity.
* **Workday Expertise & Complex Transaction Support** – Strong knowledge of **Workday end-to-end business processes**, including the ability to analyze and troubleshoot complex transactions and downstream data impacts.
* **ServiceNow Case Management & Operational Monitoring** – Strong understanding of **ServiceNow HR Agent Workspace**, including case and task functionality, SLA monitoring, dashboards, surveys, and operational case management.
* **Process Improvement & Problem Solving** – Ability to identify process gaps, perform root-cause analysis, and recommend solutions focused on simplification, standardization, and efficiency.
* **Communication & Cross-Functional Collaboration** – Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with HR, Payroll, and other cross-functional partners.
* **Training, Coaching & Knowledge Sharing** – Ability to provide process guidance, training, coaching, and knowledge sharing to support team capability and consistent service delivery.
* **Subject Matter Expertise & Functional Ownership** – Ability to serve as a functional topic owner and SME, providing guidance and support on complex HR processes.

7c955ffe8a07d9248191.description:
A **Branch Administrator** plays an important role in the organization by performing tasks related to the branch’s administrative functions. All employees are expected to carry out the company’s Purpose and Core Values.

As a **Branch Administrator** you must be able to perform the following essential functions of the job:

* Perform general clerical duties and office support, including data entry, scanning, emailing, photocopying, faxing, mail distribution, and filing.
* Assist Branch Manager and Operations Managers to support the smooth operation of the branch. Create purchase orders, receive inventory, and assist in ordering materials.
* Maintain office supplies inventory by checking stock, anticipating needed supplies, placing and expediting orders for supplies, and verifying receipt of supplies.
* Coordinate events, meetings, and conferences with cross-functional departments; prepare agendas and set up meeting facilities as needed.
* Communicate with employees in support of our core value of employee centric. Answer questions, provide direction to internal resources, and support the needs of branch personnel.
* Help ensure a positive customer experience by tracking and performing follow-up calls for all internal and external generated issues and service requests.

* Welcome visitors by greeting them, making sure they are comfortable, and directing them to the appropriate party.

* Answer incoming calls and provide responsive and courteous service to callers by providing information or routing them to the appropriate party as needed.

* Maintain uniform and PPE inventory. Distribute to employees with appropriate tracking and documentation.

* Collect, sort, and correctly distribute incoming mail and packages.
* Assist in the preparation and delivery of mailings as needed.
* Maintain a tidy and comfortable office space by picking up waste, watering plants, tidying the kitchen area, refreshing magazines, etc.
* Partner with IT helpdesk and assist in the troubleshooting of basic office technology issues.
* Assist walk-in job applicants by informing them how to apply on the employment website.
* Assist the Human Resources staff as needed.
* Maintain training records and follow-up to ensure training completion.
* Actively participate, coordinate and assist in employee recognition programs and events.
* Follow all company policies and procedures, including proper handling of confidential and private information.
* Perform any other duties as assigned.

**JOB SKILLS AND PERSONAL CHARACTERISTICS**

* Strong written and oral communication skills
* Self-motivated, proactive, results-oriented professional with an ability to work with minimum direction
* Strong customer service skills
* A positive attitude and a knack for working in a cooperative team environment
* Organized with strong attention to detail
* Excellent interpersonal skills

**POSITION REQUIREMENTS**

Must be able to pass a drug test

High school diploma or equivalent

1+ years of administrative experience

Strong computer skills in the Microsoft Suite and the ability to quickly learn new software programs. Previous experience with Aspire preferred.

Ability to type 60+ WPM

General knowledge of the landscape industry is preferred

**WORK CONDITIONS**

Employees in this position should expect to work in a typical office environment including sitting or standing for long periods of time. Candidates will perform basic office functions such as typing, scanning, faxing, or staring at a screen, for extended periods of time.

**About Us**

Clemens Uniform is a family-owned and operated uniform and linen rental company serving businesses throughout Pennsylvania, New Jersey, and Delaware since 1963. We pride ourselves on delivering exceptional customer service, quality products, and personalized solutions to our customers. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a motivated, detail-oriented, and personable Inside Sales & Customer Service Representative to join our team.

**Position Summary**

The Inside Sales & Customer Service Representative will play an important role in supporting our customers, preparing sales quotes, and coordinating custom apparel orders.

The primary focus of this position will initially be inside sales, including preparing quotes, processing orders, and assisting customers with custom screen printing, embroidery, and direct sale apparel. As the employee becomes more familiar with our products, services, and operations, the position will gradually develop into a balanced combination of inside sales and customer service.

We are looking for someone who communicates confidently and professionally, pays close attention to detail, and is eager to learn. Previous experience is preferred, but we are willing to train the right candidate.

**Key Responsibilities: Inside Sales**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for customers requesting quotes for custom apparel, screen printing, embroidery, and other direct sale products.
* Prepare accurate, detailed quotes and coordinate pricing approvals with management.
* Assist customers with product selection, sizing, decoration options, and available alternatives.
* Process customer orders accurately and efficiently, ensuring all necessary information is documented.
* Follow up on outstanding quotes, customer inquiries, and pending orders.
* Communicate with customers regarding product availability, order details, and estimated delivery timelines.
* Identify opportunities to offer additional products and services to existing customers.
* Assist with outbound sales calls and email marketing campaigns as time permits.

**Customer Service & Account Support**

* Answer incoming customer calls and provide friendly, professional assistance.
* Assist customers with uniform size changes, new employee additions, linen orders, and general account questions.
* Respond to customer inquiries regarding order status, product availability, and service requests.
* Accurately document customer requests, concerns, and account information to ensure proper follow-up.
* Coordinate with other departments to resolve customer issues in a timely manner.
* Develop a strong understanding of company operations to independently resolve customer inquiries as experience grows.
* Maintain positive relationships with customers through clear communication and dependable follow-through.

Qualifications

* High School Diploma or GED required.
* Previous experience in customer service, inside sales, or a related field preferred, but not required.
* Excellent phone etiquette and verbal communication skills.
* Strong written communication skills.
* Exceptional attention to detail and organizational abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize responsibilities.
* Comfortable using computers and learning new software.
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel preferred.
* Willingness to learn about our products, services, and internal processes.
* Experience in custom apparel, screen printing, embroidery, or uniform sales is a plus, but not required.

**What We're Looking For**

Our ideal candidate is someone who:

* **Communicates confidently:** Is comfortable speaking with customers over the phone and providing professional, helpful service.
* **Pays attention to detail:** Understands the importance of accurate quotes, orders, and customer information.
* **Is eager to learn:** Takes initiative to understand our products, services, and processes.

* **Works well with others:** Maintains a positive attitude and collaborates with coworkers to provide excellent service.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) ACES End-to-End Customer Experience (E2E CX) team is seeking an innovative, customer-obsessed, and results-driven individual to develop strategies and drive measurable improvements across the AMXL network. This highly visible, strategic role will support one of the team's core focus areas within Quality, Concessions, or Delivery Estimate Accuracy (DEA), with the overarching goal of improving the end-to-end customer experience across First, Middle, and Last Mile operations.  
  
As a Senior Process Improvement Specialist on the E2E Customer Experience team, you will focus on developing and executing long-term initiatives that improve operational performance and customer experience. This includes establishing strategies and goals, analyzing performance trends, identifying opportunities for improvement, developing scalable solutions, and driving adherence to operational standards. You will leverage data analytics, statistical methodologies, artificial intelligence (AI), and emerging technologies to solve complex business problems and improve decision-making. This role requires strong program management capabilities and the ability to collaborate across diverse, cross-functional stakeholder groups to drive alignment, execute initiatives, and deliver measurable results.  
  
To be successful in this position, you must be able to operate independently in a fast-paced, highly demanding, and often ambiguous environment while maintaining strong attention to detail. You will demonstrate exceptional analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights, develop compelling business narratives, and present strategies and recommendations to senior and executive leadership. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of influencing stakeholders, navigating ambiguity, and scaling programs that deliver sustained business improvements.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Develop and execute end-to-end customer experience strategies across AMXL's First, Middle, and Last Mile operations, with a focus on improving Quality, Concessions, and Delivery Estimate Accuracy (DEA).
* Establish strategic goals, performance metrics, and mechanisms to measure progress, identify gaps, and drive sustained improvements in customer experience and operational performance.
* Analyze network performance, customer experience metrics, and operational trends to identify defects, determine root causes, and prioritize improvement opportunities.
* Leverage data analytics, statistical analysis, and quantitative methodologies to evaluate performance, validate hypotheses, measure initiative effectiveness, and make data-driven decisions.
* Establish and continuously improve network-wide standards, processes, and operating mechanisms to reduce variation, improve consistency, and drive adherence across AMXL operations.
* Partner with Field Operations and cross-functional stakeholders to implement standards, establish accountability mechanisms, and drive sustained compliance and performance improvement.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer experience through innovation, process simplification, standardization, automation, and scalable solutions.
* Effectively leverage artificial intelligence (AI) and emerging technologies to accelerate analysis, improve decision-making, automate processes, and develop innovative solutions to complex business problems.
* Act quickly to investigate and resolve network-level quality, customer experience, and process escalations, implementing sustainable corrective and preventive actions.
* Develop clear, concise, and data-driven written narratives, business reviews, strategic proposals, and recommendations that articulate complex problems, proposed solutions, and measurable business impacts.
* Present strategies, performance insights, and business recommendations to senior and executive leadership, influencing decisions, securing alignment, and driving organizational priorities.
* Provide network-level direction on strategic initiatives, process changes, program implementations, and performance improvement efforts.
* Work autonomously to identify and solve complex business problems, understanding operational constraints, scalability considerations, dependencies, and long-term customer impacts.
* Partner with Operations, Technology, Finance, and other cross-functional stakeholders to align priorities, coordinate resources, and execute initiatives that improve end-to-end customer experience.
* Identify and address gaps between teams, processes, and systems, driving cross-functional alignment, clear ownership, and effective mechanisms to prevent recurring defects.
* Proactively identify and mitigate operational and program risks, removing barriers to execution and ensuring initiatives deliver measurable, sustainable results.

70572f7cab4e7997c82c.description:
Who We Are
  
Wellcove has been recognized as the nation’s leading full-service senior market solutions provider for over 25 years. Our solutions span the insurance senior market sector, focusing on long-term care and Medicare Supplement plans. However, we don’t stop there. Wellcove also addresses challenges faced in accident & health, disability, and supplemental health insurance programs.
  
  
Our team provides individuals and their families with peace of mind knowing their insurance needs will be met in a thoughtful, efficient manner. We are able to do this because of our dedicated associates, innovative solutions, and state-of-the-art technology.
  
  
Enrollment Specialist
  
Job Purpose
  
The Electronic Visit Verification (EVV) and Facility Enrollment Specialist is responsible for facilitating the enrollment of insureds who receive home care and facility services from provider agencies, independent caregivers, and facilities into the EVV and/or Facility program. This position primarily conducts outbound and inbound telephone outreach to educate stakeholders, guide them through the enrollment process, resolve questions, and ensure all enrollment requirements are completed accurately and timely.
  
The ideal candidate possesses strong communication, customer service, and organizational skills, with the ability to effectively manage multiple cases while maintaining compliance with applicable state, federal, and program requirements.
  
  
**Duties/Responsibilities:**  

* Conduct high-volume outbound and inbound phone calls to insureds, provider agencies, caregivers, and independent providers regarding EVV enrollment.
* Educate callers on EVV program requirements, enrollment procedures, deadlines, and available support resources.
* Guide stakeholders through the enrollment process, ensuring all required information and documentation are obtained.
* Assist providers with complete enrollment forms, account setup, and system access.
* Verify enrollment information for accuracy and completeness.
* Document all customer interactions, enrollment activities, and case notes in the appropriate systems.
* Follow up with insureds and providers to obtain missing information and ensure timely completion of enrollment.
* Respond professionally to questions, concerns, and enrollment issues while providing exceptional customer service.
* Coordinate with internal departments and external partners to resolve enrollment-related issues.
* Monitor assigned enrollment cases and meet established productivity, quality, and service-level expectations.
* Maintain confidentiality of protected health information (PHI) and comply with HIPAA and all applicable state and federal regulations.
* Stay current on EVV program requirements, policies, and system updates.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships to ensure satisfaction and compliance with EVV requirements.
* Provide training and guidance to clients on the use of EVV and Facility platforms, tools, and processes.
* Gather required information from claimants and caregivers and accurately record data in Wellcove’s platforms/systems.
* Maintain organized documentation for all client interactions, training sessions, and compliance activities.
* Provide outstanding customer service via phone and email, displaying professionalism, empathy, a sense of urgency, and a genuine willingness to help.
* Independently process caller requests accurately and promptly in Wellcove’s proprietary system and escalate as appropriate.
* Comply with customer support objectives and performance standards
* Effective use process resources to gain knowledge base and ensure the delivery of accurate information and error-free processing of requests
* Willingness to learn new duties and technology-related skills as required.

**Required Skills/Abilities:**  

* Proficiency with Microsoft office applications, Nitro, and the ability to learn multiple software applications.
* Accountable and able to work remotely and independently.
* Displays a positive ‘can do’/customer-first attitude.
* Ability to accurately document customer responses while simultaneously speaking with customers.
* Excellent communication skills and appropriate etiquette, great phone manners, and ability to speak with a wide range of personalities. Demonstrate a high level of proficiency in the use of the English language in oral and written forms.
* Collaborative team spirit.
* Ability to explain complex processes in a clear and easy-to-understand manner.
* Knowledge of HIPAA privacy requirements and confidentiality standards.
* Ability to meet performance metrics related to call volume, quality, and enrollment activation.
* Must have a dedicated remote work location free from background noises, interruptions, and desk clutter.
* Must have reliable internet connection and access to a smart phone.

**Education and Experience:**  

* High School or GED required
* Bachelor’s Degree, or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience preferred.

**Physical Requirements:**  

* Sedentary work. Repetitive motion. Substantial movements (motions) of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
* Primarily remote call-center environment.
* Extensive telephone communication throughout the workday.
* Frequent computer use for documentation and enrollment processing.
* May require occasional overtime based on program or enrollment deadlines.

At Wellcove, we strive to create an inclusive culture for all. We understand the importance of listening and incorporating various perspectives at every level of service. Our company does not discriminate based on gender identity, race, sexual orientation, age, religion, or disability.

At Beyond Finance, we've made it our mission to help everyday Americans escape the endless cycle of crippling debt and step into a brighter financial future. Through compassionate, individualized care,a culture focused on compliance and ethics, supportive user-centric technology, and customized financial solutions, we've helped over 1 million clients on their path to a brighter future.

While we're proud of what we've already accomplished, we're searching for new collaborators to help us get to the next level! If you're looking to join a forward-thinking, rapidly growing organization with helping people as its number one goal, we want to hear from you.

**About The Role**

Our Customer Success Team serves as the primary point of contact for valued customers enrolled in Beyond Finance's financial hardship programs. Our Retention Specialists play a critical role in ensuring the continued loyalty of our Beyond customer base. As a Retention Specialist, your primary responsibility will be to educate and assist clients who are facing financial hardship and exploring options to become debt-free. You will play a crucial role in retaining clients within the Beyond Finance financial hardship debt program. In this position, you will interact with clients primarily through inbound phone calls and be responsible for deescalating upset clients, empathizing with their financial difficulties, and helping them navigate the Beyond Finance program. Their primary focus is on our at-risk customers who are struggling with the use and/or value of their enrolled program, requiring creative problem solving to help them better realize and understand the value of their decision.

Key Responsibilities:

* **Educate Clients:** Provide comprehensive information about the Beyond Finance financial hardship debt program to clients, ensuring they have a clear understanding of the benefits, process, and available options.
* **Empathize and Deescalate:** Display empathy and active listening skills to understand and deescalate upset clients, addressing their concerns and alleviating their stress regarding their financial situation.
* **Navigate CRM System:** Effectively use our Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system to quickly access and comprehend client information, including their current financial status and program progress. Maintain accurate and detailed records of all client interactions and program progress in the CRM system.
* **Analyze Financial Situation:** Assess the client's current financial situation and determine the most appropriate options to help them achieve their goal of becoming debt-free.
* **Retain Clients:** Collaborate with clients to develop customized solutions that align with their financial goals, and encourage them to remain in the Beyond Finance program.
* **Achieve Retention Goals:** Meet or exceed retention targets and earn commissions based on your ability to enable clients to achieve their financial objectives.
* Above all else, provide a best-in-class customer service experience over the phone and through various communication tools responding to client requests and anticipating unstated needs

**What We Look For**

* Required - Experience in Retention, Sales, or Collections
* High school diploma or equivalent (Associate's or Bachelor's degree is a plus)
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle high call volumes
* Resilient and able to remain calm under pressure
* Demonstrated ability to negotiate and deescalate client issues effectively
* Tech saavy and proficiency with a Client Relationship Management system (CRM)
* Strong customer focus and adaptability to different personality types
* Strong verbal and written communication skills along with active listening
* Supports team/department collaboration & inclusion
* Troubleshooting and problem solving skills
* Ability to multi-task, set priorities and manage time effectively
* Willingness to adapt to a changing environment and learn about new financial solutions.

#LI-ST1

**Why Join Us?**

While you make a difference for others, we'll work to make a difference for you, providing an uplifting, collaborative work environment and benefits that reflect your value to us. For eligible full-time employees, we offer:

* Considerable employer contributions for health, dental, and vision programs
* Generous PTO, paid holidays, and paid parental leave
* 401(k) matching program
* Merit advancement opportunities
* Career development & training

And finally, our team spirit and culture! We cultivate an environment of community, connection, and belonging across our entire organization.

No fee will be paid to their parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to Beyond Finance employees or the Beyond Finance HR team. No placement fee will be paid to any third party unless such a request has been made by the Beyond HR team.*

CoinLedger has hundreds of thousands of users, has processed hundreds of billions of dollars in cryptocurrency transactions, and has partnered up with some of the largest cryptocurrency exchanges and tax software companies in the industry—including TurboTax—in an effort to bring seamless crypto tax reporting to the mainstream.

At CoinLedger, we're an ambitious, young, and agile team with a vision of building an essential piece of infrastructure for the future of digital assets. We work very hard, and we have a lot of fun doing it.

The company is headquartered in Kansas City, MO; however, true to the ethos of the crypto culture in which we operate, we are a fully remote team with members fully distributed in locations such as Austin, St. Louis, Akron, Chicago, Los Angeles, Mexico City, Zagreb, Brazil and more.

1c919044a128a6dfeb6d.title: Marketing Engagement Specialist
1c919044a128a6dfeb6d.description:
**MARKETING ENGAGEMENT SPECIALIST**

**Jani-King of Philadelphia | Philadelphia, PA**

***Build Relationships. Build Your Brand.***

Jani-King International is the global leader in commercial cleaning franchising, with over **6,500 franchisees and 120 regional offices worldwide**. For more than **55 years**, we've partnered with top organizations across healthcare, education, hospitality, stadiums, government, retail, and more — delivering professional cleaning services and unmatched customer satisfaction.  
  
We are seeking a motivated, brand-minded **Marketing Engagement Specialist** to join our Philadelphia team. This is a full-time, field-based role that blends high-energy field sales with hands-on marketing experience — you'll build your own territory through in-person outreach and networking, represent our brand at local events, and partner directly with our Marketing team on messaging and campaigns. It's a great launchpad if you're early in your career and want real experience in both sales and marketing.  
  
As the first point of contact for many potential clients, you'll play a critical role in opening doors, shaping how prospects experience our brand, and setting the stage for our sales team to close business. If you're **curious about marketing, energized by relationship-building, and driven by results**, this is a role where sales and marketing skills grow side by side.

**Position Summary**

The Marketing Engagement Specialist blends field sales with brand representation — introducing Jani-King to new business prospects through in-person visits, networking events, and strategic outreach, while also helping shape how we present our brand in the local market.  
  
In this role, you'll be the **bridge between first contact and closed deals** — laying the groundwork for lasting client relationships and visible brand presence.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Prospecting & Brand Representation**

* **High-Volume Prospecting:** Conduct daily outreach to targeted businesses through cold calls, in-person visits, and networking events to generate new leads.
* **Engage Decision-Makers:** Introduce Jani-King's services, ask discovery questions, and determine fit for our solutions.
* **Territory Management:** Plan and execute daily routes across King of Prussia and the greater Philadelphia business corridor, from Center City and University City to Conshohocken, Plymouth Meeting, and the Main Line, to maximize coverage and identify high-potential areas.
* **Brand & Event Representation:** Attend local business events, expos, and chamber of commerce functions as a face of the Jani-King brand in the community.

**Pipeline & Marketing Collaboration**

* **Appointment Scheduling:** Book qualified, high-value appointments for the sales team and ensure all details are documented in our CRM system.
* **Relationship Building:** Develop strong connections with potential customers through consistent, value-driven communication.
* **Marketing Collaboration:** Partner with our Marketing team on messaging, campaigns, and local promotional materials — sharing field insights that shape how we reach new prospects.
* **Lead Follow-Up:** Revisit prior contacts, inbound leads, and event connections to keep the pipeline active.
* **Results Tracking:** Maintain accurate records of outreach, conversations, and next steps; track activity against performance goals.

**What We're Looking For**

* Prior sales, prospecting, or customer development experience preferred
* Interest in marketing, branding, or business development a plus
* Proven ability to meet activity-based goals and performance metrics
* Strong communication skills with a professional and approachable style
* Highly motivated, organized, and able to work independently
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite; CRM experience a plus
* Valid driver's license with a clean driving record
* Reliable personal vehicle with current auto insurance coverage for daily travel

**Why You'll Love Working Here**

**Compensation Package**

**$26 – $32/hour base + monthly commission & bonuses**

*Medical, dental, vision, paid vacation, paid holidays, PTO + company cell phone & mileage reimbursement*

* **Reputation & Reach:** Join the most recognized name in commercial cleaning franchising.
* **Marketing Exposure:** Work directly with our Marketing team, gaining hands-on experience in brand representation, messaging, and campaign strategy — real skills for a future in marketing or sales.
* **Tools Provided:** Company cell phone, mileage reimbursement for local travel.
* **Established Territory:** King of Prussia and the surrounding Main Line corridor is one of the largest business hubs in the region, meaning a steady concentration of prospects close to home.
* **Career Growth:** A clear path into outside sales, marketing, or management roles — whichever direction your interests take you.
* **Impact:** Your efforts directly contribute to the growth of our regional business and the success of our franchisees.

**Location and Work Environment**

This position is based at our **Jani-King of Philadelphia Regional Office**:

**1008 W. 9th Avenue, Suite 130**

**King of Prussia, PA 19406**

You'll work in a dynamic setting that combines in-office collaboration with active fieldwork across King of Prussia and the greater Philadelphia business corridor, from Center City and University City to Conshohocken, Plymouth Meeting, and the Main Line. In the office, you'll plan routes, research prospects, log activity in the CRM, and collaborate with leadership and Marketing on strategy and messaging.  
  
This is **not a desk-bound role** — you'll be on the move, building relationships, representing our brand in the community, and discovering opportunities in person.

**Apply Today — Let's Grow Together**

If you're ready to bring your sales energy, relationship-building skills, and marketing curiosity to a role that rewards results, we want to hear from you.  
  
**“At Jani-King, we don't just build careers — we build opportunity.”**

*NO RECRUITERS OR PHONE CALLS, PLEASE*

Description
  

**Purpose of Position:**

* The Customer Service Rep I handles calls from customers to resolve, educate, follow-up and respond to questions regarding California Choice plan administration and procedures for groups, members, brokers and general agencies.

**Essential Functions:**

* Understanding of company policies and procedures as they apply to California Choice plans
* Answers questions via telephone or email from groups regarding new hires, billing, rates, supplies, administrative procedures, etc.
* Educates, via telephone or email, employees/dependents regarding ID cards, administrative procedures, dependent coverage, address changes, etc.
* Follows-up on calls and emails from brokers regarding problems that their groups are experiencing with providers.
* Ability to interact with brokers, general agents and sales representatives on a daily basis and must be able to answer questions regarding California Choice processes.
* Responds to calls from providers to confirm eligibility and benefits
* Verifies enrollments and resolves issues with carriers.
* Expedites processing of members enrollment with carrier if urgent services are needed.
* Review and submit appeal requests from groups.
* Review /Audit group billing and explain to clients in clear and accurate manner.
* Document calls in call tracking system.
* Ability to work in a paperless environment with the Doc Link system.
* Departmental standard requires each Customer Service Representative to provide Service of Unequalled Excellence to all callers by maintaining an average of 90% or greater on Call Reviews.
* Answer at least 100% of the daily call volume average.
* Provide clear and explicit documentation while maintaining percentage at a level of 90% or higher daily in applicable databases (i.e. Doc Link and Opportunity)
* Make busy time of 20 minutes or less per day.
* Meet department standards for quality and quantity of work.
* Meet department and team standards for turnaround times.
* Adhere to all HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act) and PHI (Personal Health Information) guidelines.
* On-site or remote regular attendance and punctuality are essential functions of the job.
* Performs other business tasks or functions as assigned.

  
Qualifications
  

**Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities Required:**

CA Life & Health license required. If successful applicant does not have insurance license, it is required to obtain one within six (6) months of date of hire.

Must have excellent verbal and written communication skills, especially under pressure.

Ability to handle irate customers in a courteous, patient, calm and positive manner while maintaining a high quality and quantity of work.

Experience in handling high call volume.

Must be computer literate in Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook.

Accurate data entry skills a must. Computer literate (Windows) and Word Processing Skills (MSWord). Typing at 55 WPM or more.

Knowledge of the health insurance industry and at least two (2) years customer service experience preferred.

Must be able to work in a fast-paced environment where deadlines are a priority and handling multiple assignments simultaneously.

Problem Solving Skills required.

Must have a proficient knowledge of the English language.

Proficient knowledge of the Spanish language is a plus. If hired as a Bilingual representative, Language Assistance Certification is required every two (2) years.

Additional Competencies:

Action Oriented, Approachability, Customer Focus, Humor, Listening, Patience, Self-Knowledge, Technical Learning, Time Management, Written Communication

**Educational Requirements:**

High school diploma or equivalent required.

**Physical Requirement:**

Must be able to sit for extended periods of time and occasional standing and walking. Must have adequate hearing for phone work. Vision requirements include close vision and the ability to adjust focus. Must be able to communicate effectively in English. Must be able to use a keyboard and other office equipment. Ability to lift up to 30 pounds occasionally.

Advocate Health offers a comprehensive suite of Total Rewards: benefits and well-being programs, competitive compensation, generous retirement offerings, programs that invest in your career development and so much more – so you can live fully at and away from work, including:

**Compensation**

**About Advocate Health**

Advocate Health is the third-largest nonprofit, integrated health system in the United States, created from the combination of Advocate Aurora Health and Atrium Health. Providing care under the names Advocate Health Care in Illinois; Atrium Health in the Carolinas, Georgia and Alabama; and Aurora Health Care in Wisconsin, Advocate Health is a national leader in clinical innovation, health outcomes, consumer experience and value-based care. Headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, Advocate Health services nearly 6 million patients and is engaged in hundreds of clinical trials and research studies, with Wake Forest University School of Medicine serving as the academic core of the enterprise. It is nationally recognized for its expertise in cardiology, neurosciences, oncology, pediatrics and rehabilitation, as well as organ transplants, burn treatments and specialized musculoskeletal programs. Advocate Health employs 155,000 teammates across 69 hospitals and over 1,000 care locations, and offers one of the nation’s largest graduate medical education programs with over 2,000 residents and fellows across more than 200 programs. **Remote Inbound Call Center Representative**

**Make an Impact Without Leaving Home**  
  
Looking for a remote job where your work matters?  
  
Join Principle Choice Solutions (PCS) and help support Veterans by answering questions, solving problems, and connecting callers to the information they need. Every conversation is an opportunity to make someone's day a little easier.  
Whether you're experienced in customer service or looking to grow your career, we'll provide the training, tools, and support you need to succeed.  
  
**100% Remote | Paid Training | Equipment Provided | Full-Time Benefits**  
  
**Why You'll Love Working Here**

* Meaningful work supporting Veterans across the country
* Fully remote position with company-provided equipment
* Paid training and ongoing support
* Full-time employment with a set schedule
* Opportunities for career growth and advancement
* Supportive team environment
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Paid time off, paid sick time, and 11 paid holidays
* 401(k) with employer matching
* Tuition assistance and employee support programs

  
**Compensation**

* $16.85/hour base wage
* $4.93/hour Health & Welfare Benefit (available for up to 40 hours per week)
* **$16.85 + $4.93 = 21.78/hour***(first 40 hours a week)*

***Please Note:*** *This remote position is listed under Wichita KS; however, pay is based on the applicable Service Contract Act (SCA) wage determination for the county in which the associate actually resides and performs work. As a result, the final hourly rate may differ from the posted rate depending on the associate's work location.*  
  
**What You'll Do**  
As an Inbound Call Center Representative, you'll be the first point of contact for Veterans and healthcare providers seeking assistance and information.  
Your responsibilities will include:

* Answering incoming calls in a professional and friendly manner
* Assisting Veterans and providers with questions regarding services and support programs
* Researching information and helping callers find solutions
* Documenting call details accurately within multiple systems
* Providing exceptional customer experience on every interaction
* Building positive relationships through empathy, patience, and problem-solving
* Meeting quality and performance expectations while maintaining accuracy
* Collaborating with teammates and leadership to continuously improve service delivery

**No cold calling. No sales. No collections. Just helping people.**  
  
**What a Typical Day Looks Like**  
Wondering what your day-to-day would look like? Here's a glimpse:  
  
**Start Your Day**

* Log in from the comfort of your home office.
* Check for any updates and get your systems ready for the day.
* Connect with your team and get set to help callers.

  
**Help Veterans and Providers**

* Answer incoming calls from Veterans, caregivers, and healthcare providers.
* Listen, ask questions, and help callers find the information they need.
* Provide friendly, professional support while creating a positive experience on every call.

**Use Your Problem-Solving Skills**

* Navigate multiple systems while speaking with callers.
* Research information and resolve questions in real time.
* Accurately document call details and next steps.

**Make a Difference**

* Every call is an opportunity to help someone.
* You'll support Veterans by providing information, guidance, and solutions with empathy and care.
* Some conversations may be simple, while others require a little extra patience and problem-solving.

**Keep Learning and Growing**

* Participate in coaching, training, and team meetings.
* Build new skills and gain experience in a professional customer service environment.
* Work toward quality and performance goals while receiving support from your leadership team.

**Wrap Up Your Day**

* Finish documenting any outstanding items.
* Make sure callers have received the assistance they need.
* If you're scheduled for closing coverage, you may occasionally stay a little beyond your shift to ensure all calls in queue are answered.

  
**You're a Great Fit If You:**

* Enjoy helping people and making a difference
* Communicate clearly and professionally
* Thrive in a fast-paced environment
* Can multitask between phone calls and computer systems
* Have strong attention to detail
* Are dependable and self-motivated while working remotely
* Want a stable career with opportunities to learn and grow

  
**Required Qualifications**

* U.S. Citizenship (work sponsorship not available)
* Two forms of valid identification (one must be a REAL ID-compliant or U.S. Passport)
* Ability to obtain and maintain a VA government background investigation
* Excellent customer service and communication skills
* Strong problem-solving abilities
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team
* Ability to ensure end-of-day coverage by remaining on duty until all calls in the queue are resolved. This may require staying beyond your scheduled shift when assigned to closing coverage and may result in overtime.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 1+ year of call center experience
* Customer service experience
* Experience in healthcare, insurance, government services, or related support environments
* Experience handling a high volume of inbound calls

  
**Working Environment**  
This is a fully remote position in a professional home office environment.  
Associates will spend the majority of their day:

* Using a computer and telephone headset
* Navigating multiple software systems
* Speaking with customers over the phone
* Documenting information accurately and efficiently

Paid training and all required equipment will be provided.  
Security and privacy training will also be provided to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of PCS associates and customer information.  
  
**Make a Difference From Home**  
At PCS, you're not just answering calls - you're helping Veterans access important information and support while building a rewarding career with a company that values service, teamwork, and professional growth.  
Apply today and join a team that's making a difference, one call at a time.  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**  
PCS is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.  
  
**Fraud Prevention Notice**  
PCS will never ask applicants to send money, cash checks, purchase equipment, or provide payment information during the hiring or onboarding process. If you receive such a request from someone claiming to represent our company, it is fraudulent. Please report suspicious messages to HR@principlechoice.com.

be823bcca8b72e14c30d.title: Telesales Representative – Full-Time W-2 | Remote
be823bcca8b72e14c30d.description:
**About Direct Meds**

At Direct Meds, we prioritize care, trust, and solutions that focus on the individual. Headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah, we are a fast-growing national team passionate about transforming the way people access the care they need. If you're driven by purpose and excited by growth, Direct Meds is the place to be.

Telesales Representative – Full-Time W-2 | Remote

Compensation: $41,600 Annual Base Salary + Uncapped Commission

Full-Time • W-2 Employee • Remote • Minimum 40 Hours/Week

Schedule

Monday–Friday — minimum of 40 hours per week

Available shifts:

* **6:00 AM–3:00 PM MST**
* **9:00 AM–6:00 PM MST**
* **11:00 AM–8:00 PM MST**

Shift assignment will depend on team availability and business needs.

**Note: The base salary listed above represents a good-faith estimate of the minimum and maximum target for this position. Actual compensation offered may vary depending on the candidate's geographic location, job-related skills, experience, and education.**

Top Performers Wanted

If you're the kind of salesperson who thrives on goals, loves the sound of a successful close, and consistently finds a way to hit — and beat — your numbers, we want to hear from you.

Direct Meds is looking for a high-performing, competitive, and coachable Telesales Representative to join our rapidly growing team. This is a full-time W-2 sales position with a guaranteed base salary, uncapped commission, benefits, paid time off, and opportunities for career advancement.

This isn't a role for someone who simply wants to answer calls. It's an opportunity for a proven sales professional to take ownership of a pipeline, build trust with prospective customers, close business, and earn more through exceptional performance.

If you're motivated by results, comfortable with high-volume sales conversations, and hungry to grow your income, we want to meet you.

About Direct Meds

At Direct Meds, we believe accessing medication should be simpler, more convenient, and centered around the individual.

Headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah, we're a fast-growing national company on a mission to transform how people access the care they need. Our sales team plays a critical role in that mission — combining exceptional customer experiences with exceptional sales performance.

We're building a team of people who want to win, grow, and make an impact.

What You'll Do

As a Telesales Representative, you'll own the sales process from the first conversation through the close.

**Proactively engage prospective customers through phone, email, and other channels**

**Respond quickly and professionally to inbound leads and maximize every sales opportunity**

**Conduct discovery conversations to understand customer needs and recommend the right solutions**

**Build trust and create a strong customer experience while confidently asking for the sale**

**Consistently achieve or exceed weekly, monthly, and quarterly sales goals**

**Manage a high-volume pipeline and maintain disciplined follow-up**

**Overcome objections and turn challenging conversations into opportunities**

**Accurately document customer interactions, sales activity, and pipeline updates in the CRM**

**Partner with Customer Success, Operations, and Clinical teams to ensure a seamless customer experience**

**Continuously develop your product knowledge, sales skills, and industry expertise**

**Take coaching seriously and apply feedback quickly to improve performance**

What Success Looks Like

We measure performance by results.

Top performers in this role:

**Consistently hit or exceed their sales targets**

**Move quickly and decisively on qualified opportunities**

**Follow up relentlessly without sacrificing professionalism**

**Take ownership of their pipeline and results**

**Know how to build rapport while maintaining control of a sales conversation**

**Are comfortable asking for the business**

**Learn from both wins and losses**

**Respond to coaching with action, not excuses**

**Compete with themselves and their teammates to get better every day**

If you're looking for a comfortable role where you can simply meet the minimum expectations, this probably isn't the position for you. If you're looking for a full-time career opportunity where exceptional performance is rewarded, keep reading.

Our Culture & Expectations

At Direct Meds, we hold ourselves to a high standard — both in what we accomplish and how we accomplish it.

Integrity First

We win as a team.

Protecting customer relationships and respecting lead ownership is non-negotiable. Poaching, interfering with, or taking ownership of another team member's leads, customers, or sales is strictly against our values and will not be tolerated.

We believe the best teams compete hard without competing against each other.

Coachability

The best salespeople never stop improving.

You should be comfortable receiving direct feedback, asking questions, studying what works, and immediately applying coaching to your calls and performance. We invest in people who are serious about becoming better sales professionals.

Ownership

Your results are your responsibility.

We expect our sales representatives to take ownership of their activity, pipeline, follow-up, performance, and development. We don't make excuses — we identify what's not working and fix it.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for proven sales performers, not just people who have held a sales title.

Required

* **3–5+ years of inside sales, telesales, telemarketing, or customer-facing sales experience**
* **Demonstrated history of consistently meeting or exceeding sales goals**
* **Strong verbal and written communication skills**
* **Exceptional phone presence and active listening skills**
* **Ability to confidently handle objections and close sales**
* **Comfortable making a high volume of calls while maintaining quality conversations**
* **Highly self-motivated with a competitive, results-driven mindset**
* **Strong follow-up and time-management skills**
* **Ability to work independently in a remote environment**
* **Availability to work a minimum of 40 hours per week, Monday–Friday**
* **Ability to work one of the available full-shift schedules: 6:00 AM–3:00 PM MST, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM MST, or 11:00 AM–8:00 PM MST, depending on team availability**
* **Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment**
* **Proficiency with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar**

Preferred

* **Healthcare, pharmacy, telehealth, or related industry experience**
* **Experience in a high-volume inbound/outbound sales environment**
* **History of exceeding quota rather than simply meeting it**
* **Experience selling products or services that require consultative selling**
* We care more about what you've accomplished than what your previous job title said. If you've consistently been one of the top performers on your sales team, we want to know about it.

* Develop and maintain positive client relations and work collaboratively with other departments within the company to ensure client requests and questions are appropriately handled in a timely manner
* Work independently and with a team to drive retention of clients through bolstering product knowledge and providing best-in-class service at all times
* Operate, navigate, and troubleshoot a desktop computer to obtain and extract information; research through multiple computer programs/systems simultaneously and document information, activities and changes in the CRM database (Client Relationship Management System) for client accounts. Apply various troubleshooting techniques to resolve complicated technical or configuration issues
* Continuously learn, interpret and utilize company and industry knowledge, practices, and procedures to deliver accurate and up-to-date solutions.
* Meet and exceed client centric performance expectations focused around quality of service and efficiency
* Engage with feedback to leader and team to collaborate and streamline workflows

**What We Look For**

* Minimum 1 year relevant call center experience (Required)

* Reliable, high speed internet connection with ethernet (Required)

* Excellent communication skills (written, verbal, and listening)

191e9ff56b5f9780f71f.title: National Leasing Specialist 1 Remote
191e9ff56b5f9780f71f.description:
**Position Summary:**

This is not your typical call center; you will average 50-60 prospect calls per day with the primary goal of converting each prospective customer into a scheduled in-person tour at a Weidner community or, as an alternative, a virtual tour. This role will also be responsible for live chats with prospective residents, text messaging, and future communication channels to connect with prospects along their leasing journey. A successful National Leasing Specialist 1 is able to manage their time effectively, is detail oriented, a trustworthy team player, and takes pride in their work. In addition, this position needs to be accountable and attentive in providing excellent customer service when interacting with residents, associates and vendors.

This position is designated as a fully remote role. Associates are expected to work independently from an approved remote workspace while maintaining performance expectations, professionalism, responsiveness, and customer service standards. This role requires the ability to collaborate effectively in a virtual team environment while supporting departmental and operational goals.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Answer incoming calls from prospective renters promptly, providing excellent customer service and converting inquiries into future appointments and property tours, while offering personalized assistance to create memorable interactions
* Conduct virtual tours with prospective residents with energy and enthusiasm, the Weidner way
* Demonstrate a commitment to continuous learning and growth by developing and maintaining in-depth knowledge of each property within Weidner’s 300+ property portfolio and specific amenities each property offers
* Pay meticulous attention to detail when entering prospect contact information into Yardi CRM, ensuring accuracy for follow-up purposes and effective communication between on-site staff and contact center agents
* Redirect calls to the appropriate department, property, or contact center agent based on prospect requests, ensuring efficient routing of every call
* Between phone calls, agents will manage and respond to the Yardi CRM queue, ensuring timely and accurate follow-up with all prospects
* Conduct weekly or bi-weekly follow-up calls with properties to inquire about any property-specific specials in Yardi or on hot sheets
* Actively participate in a positive team environment through teamwork, communication, and excellence in service
* Actively demonstrate the values of the Weidner Customer Service Vision to team members, associates, and external customers
* Maintain timely and professional communication with the Contact Center Manager, teammates, residents, and vendors through approved company systems and communication tools
* Provide leasing and customer service support from an approved remote work environment while maintaining established service, productivity, and quality standards
* Participate in virtual team meetings, training sessions, coaching, and departmental communications as scheduled

**Benefits & Perks**

At Weidner Apartment Homes, we value our team members and offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and career growth. Eligible on-site employees enjoy:

**Health & Wellness**

* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* Employer-paid Basic Life Insurance
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) providing confidential support for personal, financial, and legal matters; up to three sessions at no cost

**Financial Benefits**

* 401(k) Retirement Plan with company match of up to 4% of your eligible income
* Opportunities to earn leasing commissions and/or semi-annual performance-based bonuses (position dependent) tied to community performance

**Time Away from Work**

* Vacation accrual, with no usage waiting period upon accrual
* Sick time accrual, with accrued time usage eligibility after 60 days of employment
* Nine company-designated paid holidays annually

**Housing Benefits**

* Employee apartment discount available at Weidner communities, subject to availability and community guidelines

**Workplace Support**

* Company-provided maintenance uniforms

**Career Development**

* Continuing education reimbursement program after 1 year of employment, up to $2,500 per year for approved courses or certifications
* Opportunities for professional growth and advancement within a nationally recognized property management company

Join Weidner Apartment Homes and become part of a team that values your contributions and invests in your success.

**Qualifications:**

* Customer service experience required; strong interpersonal skills with the ability to deliver a positive and unique experience over the phone
* Minimum one year of experience in a call or contact center, inside sales, or multifamily leasing role
* One year of property management experience
* Yardi CRM and Paycom experience preferred; willing and able to learn new software programs and quickly adopt various technology applications
* Ability to quickly and effectively adapt to changing property details and procedures in product knowledge base
* Ability to sit at a workstation for long periods of time
* Ability to multitask while on the phone and operate multiple software programs while reducing dead air time during customer interactions
* Excellent organizational, time management, and interpersonal communication skills; detail oriented and consistently meets deadlines
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to quickly provide creative solutions to complex problems
* Ability to work overtime as requested
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with strong motivation to learn and contribute on a daily basis
* Able to give professional directions clearly in person, over the phone, email, and text
* Experienced in Microsoft products required (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook)
* Follow Weidner’s Mission, Vision, and Values and comply with all Weidner policies and procedures as well as all Fair Housing, local, state/province, and federal laws
* Must agree to a criminal background check and sign an agreement for voluntary drug testing

**Remote Work Requirements:**

* Prompt and regular attendance during scheduled remote shifts; maintain a professional appearance and represent the company appropriately during virtual meetings and resident interactions
* Maintain reliable attendance, productivity, and responsiveness while working remotely
* Ability to work a full-time remote schedule based on departmental needs; the Contact Center is open 7 days per week, 12 hours per day, and scheduled hours will vary
* Participate in virtual meetings, coaching, and training sessions during scheduled work hours
* Reliable high-speed internet connection required
* Must maintain an approved remote workspace that supports confidentiality, focus, and professionalism during scheduled work hours
* Must use company-approved devices and networks for all work activity
* Ability to work independently and manage time effectively; performance is monitored through call volume metrics, CRM activity logs, quality assurance reviews, and regular coaching sessions with your manager. Associates are expected to meet established benchmarks consistently
* Remote work experience preferred

10d087347348027afa7f.title: Sales Development Representative
10d087347348027afa7f.description:
**Who Connecteam is:**  
Connecteam is the leading platform for managing deskless teams, trusted by over 80,000 businesses worldwide. We built Connecteam for real operators - the people running shifts, jobs, and teams across stores and sites. The kind of work that doesn't happen behind a desk, and doesn't have time for messy spreadsheets, scattered group chats, or tools that don't talk to each other. Connecteam brings daily operations and team communication into one intuitive app - from hiring and scheduling to training, tasks, and day-to-day coordination. It gives teams the clarity and control to run the day, shift after shift, job after job. Backed by $220M+ from Insight Partners, Stripes, and Tiger Global, Connecteam is rapidly expanding worldwide - empowering frontline teams to work smarter, stay connected, and operate with greater efficiency.

**About the role**  
This isn't a standard SDR role.  
The Strategic SDR team operates at the intersection of Sales, Marketing, and Go To Market strategy. This team plays a critical role in testing new growth initiatives, shaping lead generation strategies, and providing real-time market insights that directly influence how Connecteam scales.  
You will work closely with Marketing and Sales to build, test, and optimize outbound and inbound campaigns, develop playbooks, and continuously refine our approach to new markets and customer segments. This is a fast-moving, high-impact role where experimentation, curiosity, and adaptability are key to success.  
If you enjoy combining execution with strategy, learning quickly, and having your insights directly influence company growth initiatives, this role is for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Execute high-volume outbound and inbound prospecting across calls, email, and LinkedIn to book meetings and generate pipeline.
* Partner with Marketing to design, test, and optimize new go-to-market strategies and lead generation initiatives.
* Track and analyze campaign performance, providing structured insights on messaging, targeting, and conversion.
* Build and refine outbound/inbound playbooks based on real-world learnings, and share best practices across Sales and Marketing.
* Thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, managing daily outreach, research, and discovery conversations while hitting or exceeding activity and meeting targets.

**Experience & Skills**

* 1+ years of SDR, BDR, or business development experience in SaaS or tech sales.
* Tech-savvy with the ability to quickly learn new tools, platforms and processes.
* Comfortable working in a fast-changing, experimental environment.
* Execution-driven with a strong ownership mentality - takes initiative and drives results independently.
* Proactive, resourceful, and able to solve problems creatively.
* Collaborative mindset, able to partner effectively with Sales and Marketing stakeholders.
* Competitive, driven, and motivated to grow within sales.

**What makes this role unique**

* Close collaboration with Marketing and Sales leadership.
* Opportunity to help build processes and playbooks.
* Fast learning environment with high visibility.
* Strong growth path

#LI-Remote

Joining Connecteam Is The Smart Move:
-------------------------------------

* **We build our people up.** Every team member is treated as a long-term investment and we recognize the value in always nurturing and training them so they can go above and beyond in their skills and job duties.
* **We make an impact on our customer's business.** We are on a mission to provide managers of all business types and sizes with the tools they need to communicate, operate, engage, and run their deskless workforce. Our product offers them an effective and affordable solution to run their business.
* **We get the job done.** Connecteam employees are passionate in executing their job duties so they can drive the company forward and provide real value to our customers.
* **We have fun!** From weekly happy hours to holiday parties, we always enjoy each other's company (and good food, of course). Connecteam is like one big, happy family!
* **Everyone is welcome.** Connecteam is committed to building an encouraging, caring, and supportive environment. We share a responsibility to support our team and enrich their lives.

**Together we will shape the future of work!**
----------------------------------------------

**Our privacy policy**
